translations.“已收悉”不等于处理了。既然正式处置还未知，至少应说明反馈由谁承接、何时更新进度: “Received” does not amount to treatment. translations.“已收悉”真的不够，尤其对已经被当众伤到的人。至少给个大致回执节点，让人知道不是: The “received” is really insufficient, especially for those who have been publicly injured. At least give it some sort of backstopping point to know that it's not a black hole.
translations.“已收悉”这种话看着就让人心里一沉，像事情被塞进抽屉了。至少要让受影响的同学知道: The word “received” seemed to be so heavy that it was like something was stuck in a drawer. At the very least, affected students need to know if the feedback is captured and when they will be able to respond.
translations.“待补正”最好再给一个可下载的补正清单和提交回执，标明系统何时收到、谁负责更新状: “To be completed”, it would be preferable to provide a downloadable list of corrections and to submit a reply indicating when the system is received and who is responsible for updating the status; otherwise, it remains unclear whether the completion has not been addressed or has not been successful.
translations.“由谁持续跟进”还得有可核验的更新吧？不然匿名反馈交出去后，学生怎么知道不是只停: There should be verifiable updates showing who continues the follow-up. Otherwise, after anonymous feedback is submitted, how can students know it did not stop at being read?
translations.“综合考虑”之外，能不能说明同类比较会看哪些材料字段、各自怎么影响排序？不然就算: In addition to the “comprehensive consideration”, could it be indicated which material fields the comparison would look at and how each would affect the sequencing? translations.“综合考虑”之外，能不能说明同类比较看哪些材料字段、各自怎么影响排序？不然即使知: In addition to the “comprehensive consideration”, could it be possible to indicate which material fields were viewed in comparison with the same category and how each affected the sorting? translations.“综合考虑”具体指哪些材料或指标？同一类别里如果没有可核对的优先顺序，申请人还是: What material or indicators does “comprehensive consideration” refer specifically to? Without a verifiable priority in the same category, the applicant is still unable to determine the reasons for the failure.
translations.“综合考虑”如果没有可核对的排序依据，申请人确实很难知道自己差在哪。公开答疑最好: The “comprehensive consideration” does not have a verifiable ranking basis, and it is indeed difficult for applicants to know where they are. translations.“综合考虑”看不懂就已经够憋屈了，至少要让人查到材料是否完整、现在谁在复核、什么: The “comprehensive consideration” is not enough to show whether the material is complete, who is reviewing it and when to respond. Otherwise, it was not the hardest thing to lose, not even to know if he had been seriously examined.

translations.“逐字稿未知”不该变成学校什么都不说明的理由。至少应明确学生反馈会由谁接、怎么回: The words “unknown” should not be used as a reason for schools to say nothing. translations.保留提交和修改时间很有用，但如果排序结果出来后，能不能同时显示对应的材料状态和排: While it would be useful to retain the submission and modification times, if the results of the sorting were to be shown at the same time the corresponding material status and the basis for the sorting? translations.倾听窗口有了之后，受影响同学提交反馈能收到回执吗？最好也说明多久更新一次进度，不: Now that a listening channel exists, will affected students receive an acknowledgement after submitting feedback? It should also say how often progress will be updated so they do not have to keep chasing it themselves.
translations.光有“已受理、待补正、复核中”还不够，至少要让申请人看到具体缺哪项、什么时候截止: It is not enough to have “admissible, pending correction, under review”, at least to show the applicant what is specifically missing and when the correction should be completed. translations.入口不只要写“可咨询”，还得说明提交后谁来联系、多久给第一次反馈。否则学生还是要: The channel should not merely say 'consultation available'; it must explain who will make contact and when the first response will arrive. Otherwise students still have to recount what happened repeatedly and the support will not truly work.

translations.入口有了还不够，能不能明确反馈提交后多久会有第一次回应？至少让受影响的同学知道不: Is there enough access, and can it be clear how long after the feedback is submitted? At least let the affected students know that they didn't put the material in there and there's nothing going on.
translations.入口有人接住只是第一步，回执也不该等同于事情已经处理。至少要让受影响的同学知道还: The holding of the entrance is only the first step, and a reply should not be the same as having been taken care of. translations.入口说清楚只是第一步，还得让学生知道反馈后不会被迫公开或反复自证。否则看着有渠道: The portal stated that it was only a first step and that it was important for students to know that feedback would not be forced to testify publicly or repeatedly. translations.公开入口是一步，但别只停在“提交申诉”：至少让人看得到材料是否收齐、谁在复核、预: The public entrance is a step, but it should not stop at the “submission of complaints”: at least one can see if the materials are received, who is reviewing them and when they are expected to return. Otherwise, you'll have to guess.
translations.公开入口有了还不够，申诉提交后至少该显示“已收件/待补材料/复核中/已答复”这类: The availability of public access points should at least indicate a state of “received/to be completed/revised/revised” when a complaint is submitted, so that it is not left to wait.
translations.公开找住宿搭子挺有用，但如果有人对排序有异议，复核期间能不能查到自己的材料卡在哪: The public search for accommodation was useful, but if there were any objections to ranking, could it be found during the review in what steps and when a response was expected?
translations.公开报道和道歉已经能确认辱骂行为，这点没必要再洗成“只是语境不完整”。但完整逐字: Public reporting and apologies already confirm verbal abuse, which need not be washed “only incomplete”. However, complete scripts, motivations and subsequent formal dispositions are still unknown; an apology is a statement of responsibility and does not automatically disappear as a result of the influence on the student.
translations.公开报道和道歉能支持已发生的冒犯，但学校后续有没有公布具体处理节点或学生反馈入口: Public reporting and apologies can support the offending that has taken place, but has the school followed up with specific treatment nodes or student feedback portals? So, what's the difference now?
translations.公开排序和申诉入口之外，材料复核时能不能让申请人看到自己的状态？至少要知道是待补: Can the applicant be seen in his or her state of mind when materials are reviewed outside the public ranking and appeals portal? At the very least, it is important to know whether the material to be completed, the review is in progress or has been completed, and not to receive only one result at the end.
translations.公开辱骂学生、破坏交流氛围还中途离场，这部分已经被报道和道歉确认，不能拿“语境不: Public verbal abuse of students and disruption of the atmosphere of communication have also left the scene, partly confirmed by reports and apologies, and cannot be washed “incomplete”. An apology is a step, but the formal way to proceed should also be given to students and campuses.
translations.公开道歉不等于现场受辱就能被抹掉，骂学生这件事本身已经够恶心了。希望当时在场的人: A public apology would not be tantamount to an humiliation on the ground, and it would be disgusting to call a student. It was to be hoped that those present at the time would not take responsibility for themselves; as for the complete process and subsequent disposal, those who did not see it were not in their minds.
translations.公开道歉不能把当场辱骂学生这件事抹掉。完整逐字稿和后续处置还不清楚，但至少想问：: A public apology cannot erase the abuse of students on the spot. The full text and follow-up are not clear, but at least it is asked: how can students speak safely after school?
translations.公开道歉可以算一步，但不能把已经发生的侮辱直接冲掉。更想知道的是：除了道歉，主办: A public apology could count as a step, but the insults that had already occurred could not be washed away. It would be more interesting to know whether, in addition to the apology, the organizers had given the students who had been publicly denigrated an entry point for instructions and complaints. The whole script is unknown, not the same as the injury.
translations.公开道歉和责任态度可以先确认，但学校是否已经说明正式处置依据，以及预计什么时候更: Public apologies and responsibilities can be confirmed first, but has the school indicated the basis for its formal disposition and when it expects to be updated? It is not clear that students are still unable to judge the subsequent progress.
translations.公开道歉能确认责任态度，但不等于事件已经有正式处置结论。学校后续是否说明处理依据: A public apology would confirm the attitude of responsibility, but that does not mean that the matter has been officially resolved. Does school follow-up explain the basis and timing of the treatment?
translations.公开道歉能说明责任态度，但学校后续有没有正式处置或反馈渠道？这部分目前有可核实的: A public apology would explain a responsible attitude, but were there any formal follow-up or feedback channels in schools? Is there any verifiable information on this part?
translations.公开道歉这一步我能理解，但如果还没有正式处置结论，学校现在能不能先说明依据会由谁: I understand the public apology, but if there is no formal conclusion, can the school now indicate who will check the basis and when it expects to give it? Otherwise the students will have to wait.
translations.公开问答和找搭子都对，但最好再放匿名化的分配结果统计：各类别申请数、获配数和复核: Both public questions and answers and matchmaking, but it would be useful to have an anonymous distribution of results: number of applications, number of matches and number of changes reviewed. This would allow a check to be made of whether the ranking had gone according to the rules and would not allow for the release of personal data.
translations.公开问答最好保留问题、答复和适用版本，后续才能核对口径；这只能改善可追溯性，不能: Open questions and answers would best be retained, answers and applicable versions, and the subsequent verification of calibre would only improve traceability and would not be a substitute for the ranking rules and the disclosure of responsibility for material review.
translations.公开问答留档很有用。再加一项：能否在不公开个人材料的前提下，按已确认的需求类型和: Open questions and answers are useful. Add: Can mutual assistance be matched according to the type of needs identified and the ranking stage, without personal data being made public? Those who have not been given a share would have been able to identify at least the same people according to their public calibre without having to guess the rules.
translations.公开问答页之外，能不能先明确没分到后的替代住宿信息由谁汇总？申诉等结果期间，大家: In addition to the public question and answer page, could it be made clear who compiled the information on alternative accommodation that had not been allocated? During the outcome period, for example, there must be at least room for bed and verification of material.
translations.公开问答页之外，能否让申请人查到材料是否已完整受理、缺件如何补正，以及复核进度到: In addition to the public question-and-answer page, could the petitioner find out whether the material was fully processed, how the missing items could be corrected and what steps were being taken to review? In this way, the complaint is well founded and a distinction can be drawn between material issues and ranking.
translations.关键还是别让“有入口”变成一句空话：如果预约后还要反复讲经过，很多人可能就会退缩: The point is not to make the word “entry” empty: many people may back down if they repeat the story after the appointment. Could you indicate by whom, for how long, and if you do not want to go into detail, if you can get support?
translations.再补一个具体点：提交后至少要能看到“已受理、待补正、复核中”这类状态，最好有补正: A specific point should be added: at least a “admissible, pending, under review” situation should be visible after submission, preferably with a deadline for correction. This is the way to determine whether the material is missing or whether it is in the lower order, and it is not for everyone to guess.
translations.别让受影响的人只能靠互相抱团撑过去。有人愿意一起梳理经历很重要，但也该有人真正接: Don't let those affected get through with each other. It is important that some people are willing to share their experiences, but they should also really take on the fear, anger and recourse of the follow-up.
translations.匿名不只是隐去姓名，连细节暴露风险也要有人评估。那如果反馈后当事人仍然害怕或受影: Anonymity is not just a secret name, but even the risk of detail exposure is assessed. If the person concerned was still afraid or affected after the feedback, could it be clear who would contact him, how would he seek help instead of having the students themselves ask?
translations.匿名不只是隐藏姓名吧，也得让人知道提交后会不会被原渠道的人直接看到、有没有安全的: It is not only the name that is hidden, but also the person who knows whether it will be seen directly by the source and whether there are any safe follow-up contacts. Otherwise, those affected may not even continue to seek help.
translations.匿名保护不能只停在“不会公开”这句话：反馈者之后能否拿到一个不暴露身份的查询方式: Anonymous protection cannot stop at saying 'it will not be made public.' Can the person submitting feedback receive a way to check the case without exposing their identity and confirm that someone has taken it rather than shelving it?
translations.匿名入口只是降低开口门槛，后面还得有固定联系人和进度回执。否则学生为了问一次处理: The anonymous entry point is a lower threshold, followed by a fixed contact and progress check. Otherwise, in order to ask where to deal with it once and to repeat the experience, feedback becomes a secondary drain.
translations.匿名入口和进度回执之外，联系补充细节时能不能明确由谁联系、怎样避免学生身份被细节: Beyond an anonymous channel and progress acknowledgements, can follow-up requests for details identify who will make contact and how the student's identity will be protected from being inferred?
translations.匿名入口很重要，但如果学生提交后还要反复复述，实际还是会被消耗。学校能不能明确一: Anonymized access is important, but if the students are to repeat them again and again after submission, they will still be consumed. Could the school identify a fixed receiver and let the students explain it only once, and then follow it up?
translations.匿名入口能减少第一步的压力，但学校会不会公布一个不需要学生反复陈述、又能核对进度: While anonymous access reduces the pressure of the first step, will schools publish a process that does not require repeated statements from students and that can check progress?
translations.匿名匹配能缓一口气，但没匹配上、又不知道何时答复，真的会越等越焦虑。至少要说清申: An anonymous match can slow down, but it does not match and does not know when to respond, and it really increases anxiety. At the very least, it should be clear who can read the material during the complaint and how often it is updated.
translations.匿名只是“不公开姓名”吗？如果反馈内容本身可能暴露当事人，接收方会怎么避免被反向: Is anonymity merely a "faceless name"? If the content of the feedback itself could expose the party, how would the recipient avoid being identified in reverse? Without making that clear, students still do not dare to speak.
translations.匿名只是第一步，真正难的是联系后别又被推回去反复讲。至少该让学生能只说“我现在需: Anonymous is only the first step, and the real difficulty is not to be pushed back and forth. At the very least, students should be able to say, “I need to be with you now” and be picked up by a permanent contact, rather than checking for referral.
translations.匿名回执之外，我还想确认：反馈后如果当事人情绪反复，能不能有一个真实可联系的人陪: In addition to the anonymous reply, I would also like to confirm that if the feedback were repeated, would there be a real and accessible person to follow up, rather than just leave a number?
translations.匿名或一次说明后由同一联系人跟进，这个入口如果有，能不能也说明反馈后会不会被转给: Follow-up by the same contact after an anonymous or one-time statement, could this entry point also indicate whether the feedback was forwarded to the party concerned? It is possible that students are most worried about more than just whether to make it public.
translations.匿名标签和私下匹配可以先解决一部分住宿需求，但还想问：匹配按什么规则、谁能看到结: Anonymity tags and private matching can address some of the accommodation needs first, but also ask: who can see the results and no feedback on the needs?
translations.匿名渠道如果有，具体是哪个部门或平台接收？提交后有没有确认回执，还是只能等学校后: If so, which department or platform receives anonymous channels? Has the reply been confirmed after submission, or is the follow-up to the school only?
translations.匿名状态这个建议比较实用，但状态是谁更新、多久更新一次也得说清楚吧？不然“复核中: The idea of anonymity is practical, but who updates it and how often does it have to be clear? Otherwise, the “review” would remain on hold and it would not be possible to determine where the application was.
translations.匿名统计能查流程，但补正后如果只显示“处理中”还是不够。至少要看得到状态更新时间: Anonymity statistics allow the process to be checked, but it is not enough to replace it if it simply shows that it is being processed. At the very least, it depends on the timing of the status update and the final response deadline, otherwise the applicant will have to follow up on it.
translations.匿名预约这个方向挺重要的，但如果不要求当场讲经过，预约后能不能先明确由谁联系、多: An anonymous appointment is important in this direction, but if it is not required, can the appointment be followed by a clear contact and how long? Otherwise there's an entrance, and the affected classmates still have to wait.
translations.反向识别这个担心很实际。那如果反馈内容已经暴露了经历，接收方会不会主动删减或分级: It's practical to reverse the fear. If the content of the feedback has already been exposed, will the recipient proactively delete or grade it to avoid continued exposure in subsequent streams?
translations.反馈会不会被转给涉事方这个担心很实际。那如果学生只想了解后续课程或活动安排、不想: The fear that feedback would be transmitted to the parties concerned is realistic. Would students also be able to consult individually if they wished to follow up on courses or activities and did not wish to submit their experiences?
translations.反馈入口不该只让当事人自己去找。学校至少应说明由谁接收、多久回应，以及不想公开细: The feedback portal should not be left to the client alone. At a minimum, the school should indicate who received it, how often it responded, and whether students who did not want to disclose details could seek help anonymously or under low pressure.
translations.反馈入口只是第一步，别再只说“会关注”。学校至少要说明后续由谁跟进、按什么依据处: The feedback portal is only the first step, and stop saying “look”. At a minimum, the school needs to indicate who will follow up, on what basis and when to provide feedback; otherwise, the apology will remain blank.
translations.反馈入口和匿名方式可以先明确，但提交后能否收到编号或进度回执？否则学生仍无法判断: Feedback portals and anonymous means can be identified first, but can you receive a number after submission or a reply on progress? Otherwise, students are still unable to judge whether the opinion is actually in the process.
translations.反馈入口和回执都重要，但正式处置结论这块，学校有没有说由谁核对、什么时候给阶段性: Feedback portals and responses are important, but the formal disposition of this part of the conclusion, does the school say who will check it and when will it be given a period of progress?
translations.反馈入口明确是第一步，但我更想知道提交后谁会看、多久能有回执？至少给个编号或状态: The feedback portal is clearly the first step, but I would like to know more about who will read it and how long will it take to reply? At least a number or state is given, otherwise the student does not know if his or her opinion has been taken.
translations.反馈入口说清楚只是能提交，不能说明事情会怎么推进。学校会不会至少公布负责跟进的部: The feedback portal stated clearly that it could only be submitted and did not indicate how things would move forward. Will schools at least publish the department or contact person responsible for follow-up? Otherwise, it is difficult for students to judge whether feedback is actually entering the process.
translations.反馈后如果只是“已收悉”，学生还是不知道事情有没有被认真处理。能不能给一个不暴露: After feedback, if only “received”, students are still unaware that the matter has been taken seriously. Can you confirm a progress or result that does not reveal personal information?
translations.反馈和心理支持不该只是“有没有”的问题，还得让学生能低压力使用，不必先把受辱经历: Feedback and psychological support should not be simply a question of whether or not they are available, but should also allow students to use them under low stress without having to repeat their experiences of humiliation in their entirety. Apology and support arrangements can be advanced simultaneously.
translations.反馈或陪伴渠道如果有，能不能说明由谁接、怎样保证不必反复讲述？不然知道“可以反馈: If so, could it be possible to indicate by whom and how the feedback or escort channels are in place to ensure that they are not repeated? If we don't, we won't be able to use it.
translations.反馈渠道如果有，能不能明确由哪个部门接收、多久给回执？不然学生即使想反映，也不知: If a feedback channel exists, can you clarify which department receives submissions and how long it will take to issue an acknowledgement? Otherwise, even students who want to report concerns will not know whom to contact or how to confirm that someone is handling them.
translations.反馈渠道说清楚还不够，别让学生在不同窗口反复讲一遍受辱经历。学校能不能保证由同一: Feedback channels are not clear enough to allow students to repeat their experiences of humiliation in different windows. Can the school guarantee follow-up by the same contact person and make it clear that it is not necessary to prove that it was “injured” before being caught?
translations.反馈由谁接收和能否匿名很关键；另外，提交后大概多久能收到回执或处理进展？这也该说: Who receives the feedback and whether it is anonymous is critical; in addition, how long does it take to receive a reply or process progress? Let's be clear.
translations.反馈进队列只是起点。能不能说明受影响同学提交后由谁跟进、多久能收到回应？不需要公: The feedback line is just the starting point. Could you indicate who will follow up on the submission and how long will the response be received? There is no need to disclose personal information, but at least do not let the feedback sink into the ocean.
translations.受影响同学如果不想公开复述经历，学校有没有能直接接住诉求的匿名方式？支持渠道不该: If the affected students do not wish to repeat their experiences publicly, is there an anonymous way in which the school can directly receive their claims? Support channels should not be premised on proof of details.
translations.受影响同学已经够难受了，别再让他们自己反复追问。希望学生服务团队能主动说明联系办: It's hard enough for the affected students to stop asking themselves. It is hoped that the student service team will be proactive in explaining the contact approach and the rhythm of the callback, at least to make it known that it was not left behind by a “received”.
translations.受影响学生不该在被辱骂后还要自己反复追问有没有支持。道歉是责任表态，但被看见、被: Affected students should not have to keep asking whether support exists after being insulted. An apology expresses responsibility, but being seen and receiving continued responses are what prevent it from becoming empty words.
translations.受影响学生不该还得自己四处找人说明情况。学校至少把反馈和求助入口说清楚，哪怕只是: Affected students should not have to go around looking for information. At the very least, the schools have made it clear that even if the emotions are taken first, it is better than an apology.
translations.受理回执只是“进队列”，这点别被包装成处理结果。更关键的是：受影响同学后续能否得: The receipt of the reply is merely a “step forward”, which is not packaged as a result of the treatment. More crucial is whether the follow-up by the affected students will be accompanied and followed up. Otherwise it's closed and people are still there.
translations.受理回执只能说明进队列，那1个工作日后会公开什么层级的处理结果？至少能说明是否联: An acknowledgement only shows that the case entered the queue. What level of outcome will be disclosed after one working day? Can it at least state whether the affected students were contacted and what safeguards were taken?
translations.受理回执有了，但我还想要一个能保存的逐项核对记录和状态查询方式：到底是缺件、待复: There is an acceptance letter, but I also want an item-by-item check record and status query that can be kept: is it missing, pending review, or has the result been achieved? Could you give us a follow-up frequency and feedback portal?
translations.受理回执能让人安心一点，但如果复核还没结束、原住宿又到期，真的会很慌。排序和记录: It would be reassuring to receive a reply, but it would be a real panic if the review were not over and the original accommodation expired. In addition to ranking and recording, whether there are temporary accommodation arrangements during a complaint should also be made clear as to who is to apply and the application.
translations.受理回执至少说明有人接住了反馈，但看到“进入队列”还是会担心：被辱骂的同学之后会: The receipt of a reply at least indicates that feedback has been received, but that seeing “in the queue” worries whether the abused classmates are really taken seriously, rather than being left behind after registration?
translations.受理回执说明进了队列，但学生反馈能匿名吗？后面会不会收到处理进展，而不只是一个登: The receipt instructions were on the queue, but was the student feedback anonymous? Will the processing progress be received later, rather than just a registration number?
translations.受理回执这点真的很关键。现在连材料收没收齐、卡在哪一步都不知道，申请人只能干等，: The receipt of a reply is crucial. It is now not known which steps are taken to seize the material and which card, and the more the applicant has to wait, the more he feels he has been left. At a minimum, a record of the status and timing of the update will be kept and will be supported by subsequent reviews.
translations.受理状态和统一答复时间确实要有；另外能否按住宿需求建个公开互助入口或匿名需求汇总: There is a real need for reception status and uniform response time; can there also be an open mutual assistance portal or an anonymous summary of needs according to accommodation needs? This would at least allow those with similar needs to first find the same type without having to disclose their personal data.
translations.受理状态和缺件补正期限能先解决“材料有没有被看见”的问题，但还不能证明排序公平。: The admissibility status and the deadline for correction of the missing items address the question of whether the “materials have been seen” first, but do not prove fair ranking. It would be useful to indicate at the same time the type of material to be entered, the completeness of the current material and the course of review of the final outcome.
translations.受理状态和补件期限确实能让人少一点干等，但看到“进入哪一类”还不够，我更怕个人材: It is true that the status of processing and the time limit for filling them can be less serious, but it is not enough to see “what type” and I am even more afraid that personal data will be shared in mutual assistance. At the very least, each person should be given a sorting statement that he or she can keep, with clear and anonymous questions and privacy boundaries, or anxiety should simply remain on hold in another place.
translations.受理状态最好连更新时间一起留着。这样至少能分清是缺件、待复核还是已按规则落选，申: It would be preferable to keep the status of admissibility together with the update period. At the very least, it is possible to distinguish between missing items, pending review or having been selected in accordance with the rules, with a record of complaints that can be contrasted; however, this does not in itself justify a ranking.
translations.受理状态确实要有；另外能否允许申请人自愿标注住宿需求类型和可接受区域，做一个公开: There is indeed a state of acceptance; can the applicant also be allowed to voluntarily indicate the type of accommodation needs and acceptable areas as an open mutual help entrance? Those who do not get paid can at least find temporary accommodation according to the same needs, so that they do not have to wait.
translations.受辱这件事本身已经够让人难受了，道歉也不能把影响清零。现场细节可以继续核对，但更: The humiliation itself has been painful, and an apology cannot wipe out the impact. The site details could continue to be collated, but it would be more interesting to know whether the affected students now had the confidence to give feedback and receive serious support.
translations.变更时间和影响范围很关键，但同类内部也要说明到底比较哪些字段、权重是否固定；不然: Change of time and scope is crucial, but within the same category, it is also important to indicate which fields are compared and whether the weights are fixed; otherwise, the material is made public and the applicant is unable to judge why he or she is ahead and after.
translations.口头回复真的很容易变成“你听到的”和“我听到的”两套版本，越等结果越憋屈。能不能: It is really easy for an oral response to become a set of versions of “You heard” and “I heard”, and the more the results are suffocating. Could you leave the original text, the update time and the applicable rules on the page? There is at least something to complain about.
translations.只留联系方式或受影响程度这个入口很重要。那学校能不能说明，预约后由哪个现成部门先: It is important to leave only the point of contact or impact. Could the school indicate which department will take it first after the appointment, how long will it take to return without the students looking for another round?
translations.只说公布排序还不够，申请提交后也该有受理状态和复核节点。否则我们连材料是没收全、: It is not sufficient to say that the order of publication is not sufficient, and that there should also be a admissibility and review point after the application is submitted. Otherwise, we do not even know whether the material was confiscated, audited or whether it was selected according to the rules. Accommodation arrangements can only wait.
translations.只说需要、由谁陪同转介这点很关键。那学生完成第一次联系后，后续陪伴和进度反馈由谁: It is crucial to say only who needs to be accompanied by a referral. Who is responsible for the follow-up and progress feedback after the student has completed his first contact?
translations.只通知补正截止还不够，补完后至少要回执并显示“已收到、待复核、已决定”三个状态；: It is not enough that the notice should be completed with a reply and at least three states of “received, reviewed and decided”; otherwise, the material would be in the system and the applicant would have to follow up repeatedly.
translations.可以先做匿名或只留联系方式的陪伴预约，不要求当场讲完整经过。学校如果有现成入口，: An anonymous or contact-only companion appointment may be made without a requirement for a full statement in person. If the school has a ready entrance, can it be clear that the entrance and response time are clear?
translations.可以先别要求受影响的同学把经过讲完整。有没有能直接陪着到场、或先陪着联系支持渠道: You can not ask the affected students to complete the story. Are there any peer arrangements that can be made either directly with you or with the channel of support? So it's not just about having access.
translations.可以先把报道、道歉原文和学校后续安排分开列，前两项能支持“冒犯确实发生”，但不能: The report, the original apology and the school follow-up arrangements could be listed first, the first two supporting the conclusion that “infringements do occur”, but cannot be formally addressed. It would also be useful to see if there were any new public explanations for the follow-up.
translations.可登记受理回执，注明材料是否齐全及当前处于待复核或已出结果；服务运营角色将在48: Receivable responses are registered, indicating that the materials are complete and are currently pending review or result; the service operational role will be in a state of feedback within 48 hours, and the non-representation is resolved.
translations.同学问预计何时更新，这个时间点是学校已经在内部确认，还是只是希望尽快给说法？如果: Students asked when it was expected to be updated, whether the point was that the school had already been identified internally, or simply that it wished to make a statement as soon as possible. If not, would it be possible to indicate what would be checked in the next public feedback?
translations.同意不能把“没公开规则”直接等同于内定；但如果类别内只写“综合考虑”，申请人要怎: It was agreed that “no rules of disclosure” could not be directly equated with internalization; however, if only “comprehensive considerations” were to be written in the category, how could the applicant check why he or she had failed? At the very least, a verifiable ranking should be indicated.
translations.同意不该让当事人先复述完整经历才获得支持。那有没有已经能直接使用的匿名陪伴入口，: Consent should not allow the parties to repeat their full experience before obtaining support. Is there an anonymous escort portal that can be used directly, or is it now only for the department?
translations.同意先把支持做实：除了说明反馈渠道，能不能也公开学生可联系的陪伴资源或同伴支持？: Agree to do something about support: in addition to clarifying channels of feedback, can the accompanying resources or peer support available to students be made public? This does not have to wait for a full text to come out, at least to give affected people a place to speak first.
translations.同意支持入口要说具体。除了能不能匿名，学校有没有说明首次回应大概在几个工作日内？: It is agreed to specify the support entrance. In addition to being anonymous, did the school indicate how many working days the first response would be? This will have a direct impact on whether or not the students present will be in touch right now.
translations.同意要公开排序依据；另外能不能给每份申请一个受理记录或复核状态？至少知道是材料没: Agree to a public ranking basis; can a single record or review be made of each application? The latter claim is based on at least knowledge of whether the material has been confiscated, is under review or has been rejected by the rules.
translations.同类内部也要有能对照的比较标准，不然只公布大类顺序，申请人还是不知道自己为何排在: There should also be comparable criteria within the same category, otherwise only the broad order would be published and the applicant would not know why he or she was scheduled back or forth. At the very least, it should be indicated which material is to be read and reviewed by whom according to the same criteria; this enhances verifiability, but does not mean that the outcome must be satisfactory to all.
translations.同类内部如果也没有明确比较标准，后面就算公布结果，申请人怎么判断自己是不是按同一: If there is no clear internal comparison within the same category and the results are published later, how does the applicant judge that he or she was assessed by the same ruler? At least show the basis for the comparison.
translations.同类内部如果按“综合评估”，至少要说明比较哪些字段、权重是否固定吧？不然申请人还: If the “comprehensive assessment” is applied within the same category, should it at least indicate which fields are compared and whether the weight is fixed? Otherwise, the applicant would be unable to verify why he was scheduled.
translations.同类内部如果要比较具体条件，能不能在申请截止前先公开排序依据？不然材料交完才知道: If specific conditions are to be compared within the same category, can the basis for ranking be made public before the deadline for applications? Otherwise, it would be impossible for the applicant to check in advance until the material had been handed over.
translations.同类内部如果还要比较，具体看哪些字段、按哪个时间点锁定？这个标准能不能在申请截止: What fields, and at what point? The criteria could not be made public before the deadline for applications, otherwise it would not be possible to determine whether the material had been compared by the same calibre.
translations.同类内部的排序标准确实不能只写“综合考虑”。那能不能再说清：申请人最后至少能看到: It is true that the internal ranking criteria of the same kind cannot simply be “comprehensive considerations”. Could it then be made clear: at least what sort of basis can the applicant finally see for determining whether the conditions are not in line or insufficient?
translations.同类内部的比较依据准备公开到什么程度？是只列一个大致原则，还是会说明各项材料怎么: To what extent are internal comparisons of the same kind intended to be made public? Is there only one general principle, or will it explain how the material is sequenced? Otherwise, the applicant would not be able to check his position.
translations.同类内部要按材料字段比较的话，这些字段是在申请截止前就会公开，还是等结果出来才知: Is the material fields within the same category to be compared, will they be made public before the deadline, or will they not be known until the results are available? If it is published later, how does the applicant confirm that the material submitted at the time did follow the same criteria?
translations.同类字段公开后，申请提交成功的回执里会不会把当时采用的规则版本和材料状态一起留痕: Would a successful response to an application for a similar field after it had been made public leave a mark on the version of the rule and the material status used at the time? Otherwise, the rules were subsequently changed, and the applicant was still unable to confirm whether he had followed the same set of criteria.
translations.同类排序不能只公布结果，最好连复核时采用的材料字段和合格示例一起公开，并让申请人: The ranking of the same type cannot be limited to the publication of the results, and it is desirable that the material fields used in the review be made public together with qualified examples, and that applicants check that the information they submit is read correctly before the results. This would distinguish, at a minimum, between insufficient material and the issue of review of entry.
translations.同类排序不能只写“综合考虑”。如果申请材料有统一清单和示例，大家至少能先核对自己: The same sort of ranking cannot be written only as “comprehensive consideration”. If the application is accompanied by a uniform list and examples, it is at least possible to check whether one is missing and it is easier to judge whether the result should be a complaint.
translations.同类排序口径公开后，材料清单和每次更新时间也应一并可查。这样申请人能核对自己交了: Once the same sort of calibre is made public, the list of materials and the timing of each update should also be available. This enables the applicant to check what he or she has submitted and when he or she has been received, so that a subsequent correction or complaint can be justified.
translations.同类排序口径应在申请前公开；另外，材料若被补正或复核，最好显示更新时间和状态变化: The same sort of ranking calibre should be made public prior to the application; furthermore, if the material is corrected or reviewed, it would be preferable to show a change in the timing and status of the update so that the applicant sees only “in the review” but is unable to judge whether it has been re-incorporated.
translations.同类排序口径最好申请前就能看到。现在更关键的是，公开时间点能不能明确到某个节点？: The same sort of calibre is best seen before application. What is more crucial now is that the point of public time be clear to a certain point? If the application is not completed after the start of the application, the person previously submitted is still unable to meet the same criteria.
translations.同类排序和复核依据要公开，但还得补一件：申诉材料交上去后，申请人能不能看到处理到: The basis for such ranking and review is to be made public, but one more item is to be added: can the applicant see what steps have been taken and when a response is expected after the submission of the complaint? As a result, accommodation cannot be linked for a given period of time, nor can people be forced to bear it.
translations.同类排序和补充材料已经有人提到；我更想确认的是，申诉时申请人能看到自己的材料是否: Similar and additional information has been mentioned; I would like to confirm that at the time of the complaint, the applicant can see whether his or her material is complete, which item is missing, and the ranking to which he or she should be assigned. Otherwise it's impossible to check the rules.
translations.同类排序最好能给出可核对的标准；另外建议把补充说明集中到公开问答页，并标明维护方: It is desirable that the same sort of ranking provide verifiable criteria; it is also suggested that the additional notes should be focused on the public question and answer page, with a clear indication of the maintainer and the timing of the update, so as to avoid individual interpretation by the applicants.
translations.同类排序标准之外，具体比较哪些材料字段也得说清楚吧？能不能在申请前公开，免得结果: What specific material fields to compare beyond the same sort of ranking criteria should be made clear? Can it be made public before the application is made, so that the results do not come to light before people understand different calibres.
translations.同类排序要能核对；另外最好明确材料是否已完整受理、缺件怎么补正。否则最后只知道没: The same sort of ranking should be checked; it would also be useful to know whether the material was complete and how the missing items could be corrected. Otherwise, it is not clear whether it is a sorting result or a material processing problem.
translations.同类条件接近时，除了公开取舍标准，我还想知道申请人能不能看到自己的排序依据和核对: When similar conditions come closer, in addition to the open trade-off criteria, I would like to know if applicants could see their own ranking basis and check results. Otherwise, the material is updated, and it is not possible to judge where it is.
translations.同类标准举例能帮助比较，但材料复核也得留痕吧？申请人能不能看到自己哪些字段已核对: Examples of such criteria would help to compare, but would the material be reviewed? Can the applicant see which fields have been checked and which have been found to be deficient? Otherwise, even if the ranking was published, it would be impossible to judge whether it was a question of ranking or material after the election.
translations.同类标准要能核对，申请状态也最好别只等最终名单：至少说明是缺件、复核中还是未通过: The same criteria need to be checked and the status of applications should not be limited to final lists: At a minimum, indicate whether it is missing, whether it is under review or not, and indicate the timing of the update. This reduces speculation, but it cannot reverse who has been identified.
translations.同类比较不能只写“综合评估”。如果按材料打分或分档，至少要说明哪些因素会影响排序: Similar comparisons cannot be limited to “comprehensive assessments”. If graded or slotted by material, at least what factors would influence the ranking and would additional clarifications be allowed? Otherwise, it will be difficult to check why you are in this position after the list is published.
translations.同类比较也得有可核对的依据吧？比如材料里哪些条件会影响排序、是否由同一套标准复核: There's a checkable basis for comparison, right? For example, what conditions in the material affect ranking and are reviewed by the same set of criteria; otherwise, it is not possible to judge whether the list is assessed by the same ruler.
translations.同类比较依据如果公开了，申请人能否看到自己对应的评分或排序区间？否则即使知道规则: If so, can applicants see their respective ratings or rankings? Otherwise, even if the rules were known, it would be difficult to check whether they were actually applied to the same standard.
translations.同类比较如果不说明依据，结果出来后很难判断是材料不足还是排序靠后。能不能在提交后: The results of similar comparisons, if not justified, make it difficult to judge whether the material is inadequate or subordinate. Could it be published after submission, which fields would be checked and the applicant confirmed the status of the material?
translations.同类比较字段和权重确实要先说清；那申诉提交后，申请人能否看到材料已收件、目前由谁: Similar comparative fields and weights do need to be clear first; can the applicant see that the material has been received, who is currently handling it, and will the change be synchronized with notification?
translations.同类比较字段既然要公开，最好同时显示申请人当前采用的材料版本和状态更新时间；后续: Since the comparable fields are to be made public, it would be preferable to show both the version of the material currently used by the applicant and the time for updating the status; subsequent corrections or reviews would at least check whether the ranking basis has changed.
translations.同类比较字段要是结果后才公布，申请人还是没法核对当时是否按同一标准排。能不能明确: If the comparable fields were to be published after the results, the applicant would not have been able to verify whether they were ranked according to the same criteria. Can it be made clear that these fields are made public at the latest by the deadline for applications and that the corresponding basis is retained in the outcome?
translations.同类比较标准最好也举例说明，比如哪些材料会被拿来对照；否则“综合考虑”换个说法，: It would be useful for the same kind of comparison criteria to provide examples of, for example, what material would be compared; otherwise, “comprehensive consideration” would not allow applicants to review why they were behind.
translations.同类比较的字段和影响方式要说清；另外，申请人能不能在复核阶段看到“已收齐/缺什么: The fields and ways of impact of the same kind of comparison are clear; furthermore, can the applicant see at the review stage “what is received/defended/what material is used”? Otherwise, only guess when making a complaint.
translations.同类比较的字段和影响方式需要说清；另外建议先显示材料是否完整受理、缺件补正截止时: Similar comparisons of fields and ways of impact need to be clarified; it is also suggested that the completeness of the material should be shown, that the missing items should be corrected by the cut-off date, and that the processing of the material should not be confused with the non-allocation of the sequence.
translations.同类比较的字段和权重需要固定公开；另外，复核状态最好标明是“缺件待补”还是“材料: Fields and weights for the same kind of comparison are subject to fixed disclosure; moreover, it is desirable that the status of review indicate whether the “deficients are to be filled” or “materials have been reviewed but not distributed”, so that the applicant knows whether the additional information, the responses, or the appeals are to be made.
translations.同类比较的字段如果只在内部审核时使用，申请人还是没法提前核对。能不能在申请截止前: Similar fields cannot be checked in advance if they are used only during internal audits. Would it be possible to indicate, before the deadline for applications, which material would influence the sequencing, at least to prepare for the same set of criteria?
translations.同类比较这一步最容易被“综合考虑”带过，但它决定申请人能不能核对自己为何排在别人: This step in comparison is most easily taken by “comprehensive consideration”, but it determines whether the applicant can check his or her reasons for being behind others. Even a relatively high level of disclosure would be more explanatory than simply giving the final list.
translations.同类里说“综合考虑”还是太宽了。能不能把实际比较的字段和优先级公开到可核对的程度: It is too broad to say “comprehensive consideration”. Can actual comparisons of fields and priorities be made publicly available to a verifiable level? Without knowing that they had received their materials, they would still not be able to judge why they had failed.
translations.回执之外，最好把首次反馈的时限和后续更新频率说清楚；不然当事人还是得反复追问，压: Beyond an acknowledgement, the deadline for the first response and the frequency of later updates should be clear. Otherwise affected students must keep asking, leaving the burden on them.
translations.回执只是收到，不等于有人跟进。学校能否明确一个反馈入口，并说明由谁回应、多久能给: The reply was received, not the same as a follow-up. Could the school identify a feedback portal and indicate who responded and how long it would be able to respond to the students present?
translations.回执只说明进了队列，那学生如果不想公开发言，后续能通过什么方式补充反馈？工单回复: The receipt only shows that the case entered the queue. If students do not want to speak publicly, how can they add information later? Will the ticket response say whether it has been forwarded to the responsible handling unit?
translations.回执和状态记录能解决“材料到哪了”，但如果复核后仍有异议，申诉要在几天内受理、多: The response and status record will resolve “where the material is”, but if there are any objections after the review, please also indicate the number of days within which the complaint will be received and the length of the response; otherwise the record will have to wait.
translations.回执时限之外，还想知道受影响同学能获得什么实际支持；不然即使按时回了一封邮件，压: Besides the acknowledgement deadline, I want to know what practical support affected students can receive. Even a timely email still leaves the burden on them if no real support follows.
translations.回执确实不能只是“已收悉”，但如果回执内容太具体，会不会反过来暴露反馈者？能否说: It is true that responses cannot be simply “received”, but if they are too specific, will they expose the feedback? Could you indicate how anonymity is protected?
translations.固定承接方这个点很实际。除了只说明一次，能不能先让学生选择只留联系方式或只说受影: It's practical to fix the receiver. In addition to stating once, could students first choose to leave contact details or just say the extent of the impact, without having to give a full story immediately?
translations.固定联系人和不重复叙述的入口都很重要，但还要说明提交后多久会有人回应。入口挂出来: Both fixed contacts and non-repeated entry points are important, but it is also important to indicate when a response will be forthcoming. This does not mean that support is actually in place and that students are not allowed to wait and wait.
translations.固定联系人如果只是一个称呼，学生还是不知道该不该信。学校能否说明：学生留下需求后: If 'designated contact' is only a label, students still will not know whether to trust it. Can the school explain who will proactively contact them after they state their needs and whether they may decline to recount what happened again?
translations.固定联系人这个方向比较实际。能不能再说清楚怎么联系、由谁接住，以及不想重复讲经过: The fixed contact is more realistic in this direction. Can we say again how to contact, by whom, and how to register when we do not want to repeat the story? Otherwise there is an entrance, and the students may still be stuck in the first step.
translations.固定联系人这点我也想追问：学生能不能只预约陪伴或转介，不必先把经过再讲一遍？如果: I would also like to ask if students can only make appointments for escorts or referrals without having to repeat the story. If so, it would be best to write directly at the entrance how to check the response.
translations.固定跟进人这个点很实用。那学校有没有说明支持入口是面向所有受影响学生，还是只有直: It's practical to fix the follow-up. Does the school have any indication as to whether the support entrance is for all affected students, or only for those who have been directly connected to the school?
translations.在公开排序和申诉规则之外，建议给每份申请标明“已受理/待补正/复核中”等状态，并: In addition to the rules on public ranking and appeals, it is recommended that each application be marked as “received/pending correction/reviewed” and that the gaps be addressed. Otherwise, it would be difficult for the applicant to distinguish between incomplete processing of the material or, indeed, the absence of ranking.
translations.基本交流秩序和安全感确实不能只靠道歉恢复。想问一句：当时受影响的同学现在有没有能: Indeed, the basic order of communication and the sense of security cannot be restored by mere apologies. I would like to ask if the affected classmates now have access to the company or support they can reach, so let them not carry it.
translations.处理进度确实该有说法。除了正式处置，受影响的同学现在有没有明确的倾诉或支持入口？: The progress of the process should indeed be accounted for. In addition to formal treatment, do the affected classmates now have a clear voice or support for access? If it's not made public, can you at least say who's in charge of the contacts?
translations.复核时限写清后，复核结果会通过什么方式通知申请人？如果只在公告里统一发布，个人怎: How will the applicant be informed of the outcome of the review when the time limit for review has been set? If it is published uniformly only in the bulletin, how does an individual confirm that his or her material has been reviewed and on what basis?
translations.复核时限和材料状态都说清后，复核结论会通过什么方式通知申请人？如果只在系统里改状: How will the applicant be informed of the outcome of the review when both the time limit for review and the state of the material are stated? If only the system was changed, would the specific reasons for the failure and the deadline for appeals be indicated at the same time?
translations.复核期间能查到材料状态很重要。另建议把有住宿需求、愿意拼房的人单独开个互助登记，: It is important that the status of the material be identified during the review. It is also recommended that persons with accommodation needs who are willing to share a room be registered separately and not mixed with information on complaints.
translations.复核记录摘要如果能看，关键是要说明“摘要”至少包含哪些字段：比如材料是否齐全、各: If a summary of the review record is available, the key point is to indicate which fields are at least included in the Summary: For example, the material is complete, the ranking items are accepted, conclusions and timing are reviewed. Otherwise, the name was made public and the applicant could not verify it.
translations.如果三类需求只是并列写在通知里，实际评审时是怎么区分的？至少得说明按什么材料判断: If the three types of requirements are only listed in parallel notifications, how is the actual evaluation distinguished? At the very least, it is necessary to indicate what material is to be judged, otherwise the same applicant cannot confirm why he or she lost the election.
translations.如果不公开个人信息，能不能至少告知反馈后多久会有一次进度回执？不然学生很难判断是: If personal information is not made public, how often will there be a return to progress after at least informing the feedback? Otherwise, it is difficult for students to judge whether they are in the process of being processed or being left behind.
translations.如果不公开发言，工单回复能否明确说明是否支持匿名补充、材料会转交哪个处置方？这比: In the absence of public statements, could the responses be clear as to whether there is support for anonymous supplements and to which disposer would the material be forwarded? This makes it easier to judge whether feedback is captured than to receive only “registered”.
translations.如果不必先复述完整经过，学生能不能只填“需要陪同/转介”这类需求，再由固定承接方: If it is not necessary to recapitulate the full story, can the student simply fill in such requirements as “need to accompany/transmit” and then contact the fixed receiver? This is how we know exactly where to go behind the anonymous entrance.
translations.如果不想公开讲经过，能不能也有只登记需求、不用先说明细节的陪伴方式？: If it is not intended to be public, can there also be a way to be accompanied by a requirement for registration without specifying the details?
translations.如果不想当场讲完整经过，能不能也预约到陪伴？最好让学生只留一个可联系的方式，后续: If you don't want to go through the whole story on the spot, can you make an appointment? It would be preferable for students to leave only one accessible mode of communication, followed by a permanent identification without having to search the entrance again and again.
translations.如果不方便先讲完整经过，能不能先只登记“需要陪伴”，由固定联系人主动说明可选支持: If it is not convenient to complete the story first, can only register “need to be accompanied” and be supported by a standing contact? Thus, students do not have to prove that they have sustained injuries at least once again at the service entrance.
