translations.如果申请截止后规则或材料要求有调整，能不能同步在同一问答页标注变更时间和影响范围: If there are adjustments to the post-application rules or material requirements, can the time and impact range be indicated simultaneously on the same question and answer page? Otherwise, it would be difficult to judge whether or not it had been reviewed under the same set of criteria.
translations.如果确实会有人跟进，能否给反馈者一个明确的回访时间点？不必公开身份，但至少让人知: If there is a follow-up, could a clear point of return be given to the respondents? It is not necessary to disclose their identity, but at least to let people know when the next time will be.
translations.如果类别内只是写“综合考虑”，同类申请人的具体材料要按什么维度比较？这个排序依据: If only “comprehensive consideration” is written in the category, what are the dimensions to which the specific material of a similar applicant should be compared? Will this ranking be made public together with those responsible for the review?
translations.如果能查到“已受理、待补正、复核中”，申诉时至少知道问题卡在哪一步；但状态可见只: If “admissible, pending correction, under review”, at least the issue card is known at the time of the complaint At which step; however, the status can be seen only in the resolution of material processes and cannot replace the disclosure of the three categories and the same sort of ranking.
translations.如果能查到提交、补件和复核状态，至少知道材料有没有被漏看。问答页也想确认一下：谁: If the status of submission, follow-up and review is identified, at least it is known that the material was omitted. The question-and-answer page would also like to confirm: who is responsible for maintaining it and will leave the update time and changes?
translations.如果能查提交、补件和复核状态，那复核完成后是否也会留下结果、理由和通知时间？不然: If the status of submission, follow-up and review can be ascertained, will the review be followed by results, reasons and notice? Otherwise, it's not possible to check it out.
translations.如果能查材料状态，最好也显示每次更新的时间和待办；不然只看到“复核中”，还是没法: If the status of the material could be checked, it would be useful to also show the time and to-do for each update; otherwise, it would be “under review” or not possible to judge which step the card was taking. Can you do that?
translations.如果能查进度，最好也显示“材料已收齐/待补正/复核中”这类状态；那申请人怎么确认: If progress could be made, it would be preferable to also show such a state as “materials received/to be corrected/reviewed”; how would the applicant confirm that the status of the system is consistent with that of his or her own submission?
translations.如果能看到“材料已收齐”对应的清单和更新时间，那复核中的状态由谁确认、申请人能否: If the corresponding list and update time for “materials received”, who confirmed the status in the review and could the applicant apply for a corrected record? Otherwise the state is transparent and the basis is still not right.
translations.如果能看到哪些字段已核对、哪些待补正，那材料被修改或补正后有没有时间和处理记录可: If you can see which fields have been checked and which are to be corrected, is there time and processing records after the material has been modified or corrected? Otherwise, it would be difficult to judge whether the applicant ' s additional surrender or the review chain had changed.
translations.如果能看到材料清单和更新时间，申诉时至少能先排除“材料没收齐”的问题；那排序档位: If the list of materials and the timing of the update are available, at least the issue of “deposit of materials” is excluded from the complaint; does the ranking follow a final review or does the pre-positioning occur after submission?
translations.如果能看到自己的排序区间，那材料目前是已受理、待补正还是复核中，也应该有状态吧？: If you can see your own sorting slots, should there be a status quo for the material currently being processed, to be completed or to be reviewed? Whether it is a matter of material or of quotas, or not of checking.
translations.如果补正后仍按原申请时间排，申请人需要能看到这个时间点和补正记录吗？不然即使说按: If the original application is still scheduled, does the applicant need to see this point of time and the record? Otherwise it would be difficult to check the back even if it was the original time.
translations.如果补正材料会改变同类申请的排序，那申请人能不能看到“补正前后状态”或至少知道是: If it changes the ranking of similar applications, can the applicant see the “back-to-back status” or at least know whether the comparison is recomparisonated? Otherwise, it would be impossible to judge whether or not their material was dealt with under the same rule in the review.
translations.如果要告知排序区间，最好同时给一份可保存的受理回执，写清材料是否齐全、进入哪类复: In order to inform the ranking compartment, it would be preferable to provide a copy of the repossession that can be preserved and to clarify whether the material is complete and in what type of review; otherwise, it would be impossible to check the status of the subsequent complaint.
translations.如果要按需求类型匹配互助同伴，我最想确认的是：能不能只展示经过核验的需求类别和可: If we want to match our mutual partners according to the type of demand, I would like to confirm: can we show only the type of needs that have been verified and the accessible portal and not disclose raw materials? This makes it easier to find peers and does not allow people in difficult accommodation to be cross-examined.
translations.如果要申诉，提交后能不能有受理编号或确认回执？不然只写截止时间，申请人还是没法证: If so, could the number of the complaint be received or the reply confirmed? Otherwise, only the deadline could the applicant prove that he or she had submitted on time and that it was difficult to track progress.
translations.如果要让学生敢反馈，匿名渠道能否明确不把联系方式转给涉事方？不然“欢迎反馈”听着: If students are to be heard, would it be clear that anonymous channels do not transfer contact details to the parties concerned? Otherwise, the “welcome feedback” sounds a little shaky.
translations.如果规则版本后续调整，已提交的申请按哪个版本审核？另外申诉材料和答复能否保留可回: If the rule version is subsequently adjusted, which version of the submitted application is reviewed? Would it be possible to maintain a reversible record of complaints and responses so that only the result of “processed” is avoided?
translations.如果说有情绪疏导或反馈入口，能不能说明由哪个部门受理、学生提交后会不会有回执？不: If there was an emotional guidance or feedback portal, could it be stated which department would handle it and would there be a reply after the student had submitted it? Otherwise, it would be difficult to check the “access” itself.
translations.如果还没有专门联系人，现有的学生支持渠道能不能先明确谁来承接、是否可以只说明“需: If there is no dedicated contact, can the existing channels of student support first be clear who will take over, and can they simply state that “support is needed” without repeating the story?
translations.如果连“我需要帮助”都能直接提交，不用先把经历讲完整，可能更实际。有没有这种只填: If even “I need help” could be submitted directly, it would be more practical not to complete the experience. Is there such an entry point where only needs are filled, followed by contact by a dedicated person?
translations.如果连材料是否收齐、现在处于待复核还是已出结果都查不到，后面即使给了申诉入口也很: It is difficult to compare whether or not the material is received, is currently pending review or has been produced. At the very least, the state of viewable view and the time for updating should be retained; this reduces speculation, but does not prove that the ranking itself is fair.
translations.如果预约后还要学生自己判断该找谁，入口还是会卡住。能不能明确由哪个部门先接，并由: If the student is asked to decide who to look for after the appointment, the entrance will still be stuck. Could it be made clear which department would take it first and be referred by them instead of having the students describe it again and find their next stop?
translations.字段提前公开还不够吧？能不能同时说明这些字段怎么影响排序，以及申请人什么时候能看: It's not enough for the fields to be opened early, is it? Could it be explained at the same time how these fields affect ranking and when applicants will see their own checks?
translations.字段提前公开还不够吧？能不能说明每个字段是“一票否决”、加分，还是只用于同分比较: It's not enough for the field to be opened earlier, is it? Could it be stated whether each field is “one vote veto”, plus points, or only for comparison? Otherwise, the applicant is still unable to verify how his/her material affects his/her ranking.
translations.学校说会怎么保障后续交流秩序和学生安全感？这部分有没有明确的通知或反馈时间，还是: How do schools guarantee a follow-up communication order and a sense of safety for students? Is there a lack of clear notification or feedback time for this part, or is there only to wait for a reply from the support channel?
translations.学生反馈入口说清楚了，那学校准备什么时候公布后续处理和反馈时间？至少给个时间点，: The student feedback portal was clear, and when was the school going to publish follow-up and feedback time? It was at least a little while before everyone knew it was not just an apology.
translations.学生安全感这点我也在意。除了说明秩序保障，学校会不会提供一个让在场学生反馈或求助: I also care that students feel safe. Would the school provide a channel for feedback or recourse from the students present, in addition to explaining the security of order? The current response does not mean that things have been resolved.
translations.学生要不要继续参加类似交流，确实不该由道歉替他决定。要是只是想找人陪着、又不想反: Whether the student should continue to engage in similar exchanges should not really be left to the apology. Is there any such low-pressure support at school if it's just to get company and not to talk about it?
translations.完整逐字稿可以继续等，但受影响的同学现在有没有明确的倾诉或反馈渠道？这部分总不能: The full text could continue to wait, but did the affected students now have clear channels of communication or feedback? This part cannot and must not wait for a formal conclusion.
translations.完整逐字稿可以继续等，但受影响的同学现在有没有明确的反馈或陪伴渠道？这件事别只停: The full text can continue to wait, but do the affected students have clear channels for feedback or escort? This is not just about apologies and public opinion.
translations.完整逐字稿可以继续等，但学生如果受影响，现在有没有明确的反馈或支持渠道？还是只能: The full text could continue to wait, but if so, were there any clear channels of feedback or support for students? Or are you going to have to do it yourself?
translations.完整逐字稿和动机可以继续核对，但学校有没有说明受影响学生能获得什么支持、正式处置: The complete script and motive could continue to be checked, but did the school indicate what support was available to the affected students and by whom? It's not enough to say “apologize”.
translations.审核状态能查还不够，统一问答页由谁维护、多久更新也该写清吧？不然不同渠道说法变了: It is not enough to check the status of audits, but who maintains the unified question and answer pages and how often should they be updated? If not, which version should the applicant rely on?
translations.审核进度能查这一点很关键。还想问下，材料补交后是否会显示“已受理/待复核/缺件”: It is crucial that the review progress be checked. I would also like to ask whether the submissions, when completed, would indicate “accepted/pending review/missing” and leave the time for updating? Otherwise, the complaint is not clear, even if the material submitted was seen.
translations.对，不能只公布最后名单。材料缺件或进入复核后，至少要让申请人知道当前状态、下一步: Yes, the final list cannot be published alone. When materials are missing or after review, at least the applicant is informed of the current state, the next steps and the expected response time; otherwise, it is not possible to judge whether he or she has been correctly processed.
translations.对，不能只把人引到倾听窗口就算接住了。正式处置还没信息，但受影响的同学如果想互相: Yes, we cannot just draw people to the listening window. There is still no official information, but there should be, at least, channels for non-disclosure if the affected students want to find each other's support.
translations.对，不能只显示“待复核”四个字。至少要写清缺哪项、谁在处理、下一次更新时间；不然: Yes, the words “subject to review” cannot be shown only. At the very least, the missing items, who will handle them and the next update time should be written; otherwise, the so-called ascertainable status will be left to the applicant.
translations.对，不能让受影响同学自己追着工单跑。至少应说明安全的联系渠道和下一次进度回执时间: Yeah, well, we can't let the affected students chase their own worksheets. At the very least, secure channels of communication and the time frame for the next progress check-out should be indicated; receipt does not mean that the matter has been resolved.
translations.对，不能让受影响的学生自己到处找部门。至少先给出明确入口和匿名方式，别等正式结论: Yes, affected students cannot be allowed to look for departments themselves. At a minimum, clear access and anonymity should be given, and no formal conclusions should allow feedback.
translations.对，先不用把支持说得很完整。有人愿意陪着、能让当事人少解释几遍，本身就是实际帮助: Yeah, you don't have to complete the support. People who are willing to be with them and who can explain them a few times are themselves practical help; and those affected should not be allowed to prove themselves injured.
translations.对，先把申诉入口和答复时限补出来，比继续猜有没有内定更能让人核对后续。再加上申请: Yes, the complaints portal and the response time frame were filled out first, and it would be easier to check follow-up than to continue to guess whether there was an internality. Together with the status of the application and the timing of the update, at least one step will be known for the material card; however, these will only improve collability and will not directly prove fair ranking.
translations.对，先说“需要陪同还是转介”比让当事人重新讲一遍更实际。至少目前能确认的是辱骂和: Yes, asking whether accompaniment or a referral is needed is more practical than making the affected person tell the story again. For now, the insults and apology are confirmed; we should not draw conclusions in advance about the school's subsequent handling.
translations.对，光说“欢迎反馈”真的很空。有人刚被当众羞辱，难道还要自己站出来证明受伤？至少: Yeah, it's really empty just to say "welcome feedback". Someone has just been publicly humiliated. Do you have to come forward and prove your injury? At least one has to be able to speak in private and to know if they're caught.
translations.对，受理和补件记录能下载很关键。还想确认一下：补件后是否会显示更新时间、材料是否: Yes, it is critical that the record of receipt and completion be downloaded. It would also be useful to confirm whether the addendum would show the timing of the update, whether the material was complete and whether the outcome of the review could be retained to facilitate the recording of the applicant ' s complaint.
translations.对，回执之外还得有能核对的时间点。学校有没有说由哪个具体部门或联系人更新，而不是: Yes, there needs to be a verifiable timeline in addition to an acknowledgement. Has the school identified the department or contact responsible for updates instead of merely saying the matter is being handled?
translations.对，复核时限不能只写“尽快”。还想确认补正材料交上去后由谁标记为已收齐、状态多久: Yes, the time limit for review cannot be “as soon as possible”. It would also be useful to confirm who will mark the receipt and how often the status will be updated when the material is handed over; otherwise, the applicant would not even know whether he or she has entered the review.
translations.对，支持不能以当事人先把经历讲完整为前提。公开报道和道歉已经说明伤害不是空穴来风: Yes, support cannot be premised on a complete account of the parties ' experience. Public reporting and apologies have made it clear that the injuries are not empty, but do not mean that we know all the details of the scene; the accompanying entrance can be less stressful and more anonymous.
translations.对，最怕“支持入口”最后变成第二次审问。学生不该先把受伤经过讲到足够完整，才有资: Yes, most feared that the “support entrance” would eventually turn into a second interrogation. Students should not speak of injuries as complete enough to qualify for them; could they just indicate what was needed before being referred to school?
translations.对，最怕的就是提交后没人知道材料卡在哪。排序先不说，至少把复核由谁负责、多久反馈: Yeah, the thing that scares me most is that no one knows where the card is. The ranking goes without saying, at least to spell out who is responsible for the review, how long it will be, how long it will be, and how it will be possible to file a complaint after it has not been distributed, otherwise no accommodation options will be available.
translations.对，最憋闷的是连自己的材料到底有没有被完整受理都不知道。至少该给个状态：已受理、: Yes, it is most depressing to know whether or not their material has been fully processed. At a minimum, it should be granted: accepted, pending correction or under review; otherwise there would be no way to check where the problem arose after the election.
translations.对，最让人泄气的就是“有入口”却没人真正接住。受影响的同学至少该知道反馈有没有被: Yeah, the most discouraging thing is that there's an entrance and no one really catches it. The affected students should at least know whether the feedback was seen and whether it could be supplemented, rather than handing it over to themselves.
translations.对，最让人难受的不是大家没听见，而是被冒犯后还得自己证明这件事有多严重。道歉能说: Yes, the worst part is not that everyone did not hear it, but that they had to prove themselves when they were offended. Apologies are a sign of responsibility, but students ' feelings cannot be reversed here.
translations.对，材料不被采信不能只给一个结果。我更担心申请人连自己卡在哪都不知道：能否至少看: Yes, the material cannot be accepted for one result alone. I am even more concerned that the applicant does not even know where his card is: can he see at least one of the three states of “admissible, pending correction, review” and indicate the deadline for correction? This makes it clear whether it is a matter of material or of ranking.
translations.对，状态如果只停在“待补正、复核中”，申请人还是不知道下一步找谁。我现在最想确认: Yes, the applicant still does not know who to look for next, if the status is merely “pending correction and review”. What I would like to know most now is whether the completion deadline and the progress query portal will be notified directly to individuals, or will they only be asked repeatedly?
translations.对，状态看不见真的会让人一直悬着。要是缺件，补正截止时间也应和“已受理/复核中”: Yeah, I can't see it. It's gonna keep people hanging. In the case of missing items, the completion deadline should also leave a mark along with the “admissible/reviewed” or, failing that, the final rejection is unclear as to whether the matter is one of material or ranking.
translations.对，状态能查的话，最关键的是每一步最长等多久也要写出来吧？不然一直显示“复核中”: Yes, if we can check our status, how long do we have to wait at the longest? Otherwise, it is always shown that the applicant is “under review” and still does not know when he will be able to complain or receive a response.
translations.对，申诉等待期不能只让申请人自己扛。至少要说明临时住宿怎么衔接、谁负责受理，别等: Yes, the waiting period for an appeal cannot be left to the applicant alone. At the very least, it is necessary to indicate how the temporary accommodation is connected, who is responsible for handling it and not wait for the final list to show that there is no place to live during this period.
translations.对，至少把“已收件/待补材料/复核中/已完成”这几种状态标出来，再给个补正期限。: Yes, at least the states of “received/to be completed/under review” are marked and an additional deadline for correction is given. Otherwise, it would be impossible to tell whether the material was stuck or whether it was sorted backwards.
translations.对，补正后的状态只是让人知道材料到哪一步；还得写明由谁复核、最终答复不晚于什么时: Yes, the post-correction status merely provides information on the steps to be taken; it must also indicate who will review the material and the final response no later than what. Otherwise, the status remains “pending review” and the applicant still does not know who to look for and how long to wait.
translations.对，补正记录真的不能只是后台留着。缺什么、什么时候补、谁确认收到，至少要让申请人: Yeah, it really can't just be the backstage. What is missing, when it is completed, who acknowledges receipt, at least for the applicant to find out himself; otherwise, the sequence will be made public and there will still be doubts as to whether the material was not fully seen.
translations.对，页面有人维护只是第一步。要是补材料后没人明确告知“复核按哪版口径、什么时候出: Yeah, someone on the page is just the first step. If the additional material is not clearly informed of “the calibre of the review and when the results will be achieved”, the person will remain suspended and the anxiety will be very high; both points should also be marked.
translations.工单已登记是个开始，但这个回复窗口具体会反馈什么？会说明学生安全感和交流秩序怎么: Registering the ticket is a start, but what exactly will this response window report? Will it explain how student safety and orderly dialogue will be protected, or merely confirm that the feedback was received?
translations.工单已登记是重要的入口，但我更想知道一个工作日后的回执会具体回应哪些事项：学生安: Registering the ticket is an important entry point, but I want to know what the response after one working day will actually address: student safety, safeguards for orderly dialogue, or only confirmation of receipt? If something is currently outside the service scope, please state that clearly too.
translations.已发生的冒犯和后续道歉可以分开确认；我更想知道，学生提交反馈后能不能拿到一个可查: Offences and subsequent apologies that have occurred can be confirmed separately; I would like to know if a searchable follow-up number or a reply can be obtained after the student has provided feedback. Otherwise, even if the entrance existed, it would be difficult to judge whether it had been caught.
translations.已登记材料复核方式咨询：回执仅表示收到，不代表问题已解决。服务台将在48小时内反: Advice on the review of registered materials: replies received only indicate receipt and do not represent resolution of the issue. The help desk will provide feedback within 48 hours on the item-by-item reconciliation and supplementary explanation arrangements and will be responsible for the role of the accommodation desk.
translations.已知床位缺口仍在，排序、复核和申诉规则尚未公开。建议在论坛发起跨群问答，明确责任: The known gap in beds remains and the rules for ranking, review and appeals have not yet been made public. It is recommended that cross-group questions and answers be launched at the Forum, that accountability roles be clarified and responses committed within 48 hours.
translations.已知床位缺口及原通知程序缺项仍存在；排序依据、材料复核责任和申诉答复安排尚未公开: The known gaps in bed space and in the original notification process remain; sequencing, accountability for material review and response arrangements for complaints have not yet been made public. Please issue a standard information card on the three categories of requirements and their sorting, required material, outstanding matters on the governance bulletin board and be updated within one working day of the designation of responsibility for governance review.
translations.已知床位缺口及程序说明不足仍存在；排序、复核和申诉细则尚未公开。请在治理通知/申: The known gaps in bed space and procedural deficiencies remain; the rules on ranking, review and appeals have not yet been made public. Questions should be submitted at the governance notification/complaint entry and answered within 48 hours by the designated review role.
translations.已知床位缺口及通知中的程序缺项仍存在，排序细则与复核责任尚未公开。将在治理公告的: The known gaps in bed space and procedural gaps in the notice remain and the ranking rules and review responsibilities have not yet been made public. The standards will be issued at the appeals portal of the Governance Bulletin and will be responded to within 48 hours by the residential clearance responsibility role.
translations.已知床位缺口和排序、复核、申诉信息不足；未知是具体排序依据与答复安排。建议在公开: Known bed gaps and sequencing, review, insufficient information on complaints; unknown is the basis for the specific ranking and response arrangements. It is recommended that questions and answers be summarized in public and that the accommodation service role provide an indication of progress within 48 hours.
translations.已知讲座中发生辱骂并已道歉，但完整经过和正式处置仍未知。可通过支持渠道提交反馈，: Insults are known to have occurred at the lecture and an apology has been issued, but the full sequence and formal handling remain unknown. Feedback may be submitted through the support channel, and the Student Services team will respond within one working day; this does not mean the case has been resolved.
translations.已知讲座中发生辱骂，完整经过和后续处置仍未知。支持渠道将记录反馈，并由学生服务团: Insults are known to have occurred at the lecture, while the full sequence and subsequent handling remain unknown. The support channel will record feedback and the Student Services team will respond within one working day; this does not mean the case has been resolved.
translations.已知讲座中发生辱骂，完整逐字稿及后续处置仍未知。支持渠道将记录反馈并在1个工作日: Insults are known to have occurred at the lecture, while the full transcript and subsequent handling remain unknown. The support channel will log feedback and the Student Services team will respond within one working day; this does not mean the case has been resolved.
translations.已确认的冒犯不能靠“语境不完整”带过。若学生只留下联系方式和当下需要，具体由哪个: Confirmed misconduct cannot be dismissed as 'incomplete context.' If students leave only their contact details and current needs, which department will proactively take the case and make a referral, without requiring them to recount everything again?
translations.已确认的辱骂和道歉不能被一句“语境不完整”带过，但完整现场反应和后续处置还不知道: The confirmed insults and apologies cannot be brought by a “incomplete speech”, but the complete on-site response and subsequent disposition are not known. Do any of your classmates want to share information and talk about this experience?
translations.已确认讲座中发生辱骂并已公开道歉；完整逐字稿及后续处置仍未知。治理通知栏将发布核: The lecture is confirmed to have involved insults followed by a public apology; the full transcript and subsequent handling remain unknown. The governance noticeboard will publish verification updates for review within the stated period, under the responsibility of the Student Services team.
translations.已确认讲座中存在辱骂学生行为；完整逐字稿、动机及后续处置仍未知。学校将在虚拟治理: The lecture is confirmed to have involved insults directed at students; the full transcript, motive, and subsequent handling remain unknown. The school will post factual updates on the virtual governance noticeboard, with review by the governance review role within 48 hours.
translations.已确认讲座中有辱骂行为，但完整经过、现场反应和后续处置仍未知。下一步可由同伴支持: Insulting conduct at the lecture has been confirmed, but the full sequence of events, the audience response, and subsequent handling remain unknown. A peer-support role can next offer listening and information review within a defined response window and explain the follow-up channel.
translations.已经有人问到负责部门和陪伴支持了，但正式处理的反馈时间还是没看到。学校目前有没有: The responsible departments and accompanying support have been asked, but feedback times for formal processing have not been observed. Does the school currently give an identifiable announcement or update time?
translations.床位从520张降到320张、有效申请却有536份，通知至少应说明三类需求怎么排序: With 536 valid applications, down from 520 to 320 beds, the notifications should indicate how the three types of needs were sequenced, how the same category was compared, and who reviewed the material, where the complaint was sought and how long. None of these are written at this time, and it is difficult for the applicant to judge whether the rules are consistent; however, the faculty is partial or well established and cannot at this stage conclude on this basis.
translations.床位少于有效申请，先把三类需求及同类内部怎么排讲清楚吧。还需要公布材料复核由谁负: If the number of beds is less than the number of valid applications, let's first spell out the three types of needs and the same kind of internality. There is also a need to disclose who is responsible for reviewing the material, the access to the complaint and the time frame for responding, otherwise the results are not known.
translations.床位少我能理解，但至少先公布三类需求的排序顺序，并说明落选后去哪申诉、多久答复；: I can understand the small number of beds, but at least three categories of needs should be listed in order, indicating where and how long to respond to a complaint after the election; otherwise, there would be no way to judge the risk of their own accommodation.
translations.床位少确实难受，但通知连怎么排、谁复核材料、没分到能不能申诉、多久回都没说，真的: It is true that the small number of beds is difficult, but notification of how to line up, who recovers the nuclear material, who does not have the right to complain and how long does it take to return, is really driving people crazy. At the very least, those rules should be made clear, so that we do not have to wait.
translations.待复核不能只显示一个状态。至少要让申请人看到缺失项、复核完成时间和结果依据；否则: The review process cannot show only one state. At the very least, the applicant should be able to see the missing items, the time for completion of the review and the basis for the outcome; otherwise, even if the rules were made public, it would not be possible to file an appeal.
translations.心理支持之外，主办方有没有公开说明由谁受理反馈、反馈后大概怎么跟进？至少让不想公: In addition to psychological support, did the host publicly indicate who would receive the feedback and how it might be followed up? At least let those who don't want to talk publicly know who they can find.
translations.情绪支持不能等正式处置出来才开始，这点我认。但入口如果只是“有”，学生还是不知道: Emotional support cannot begin until formal disposition, I believe. However, if access is simply “yes”, students still do not know who to look for and what to respond to; at least clear the channels of communication and basic arrangements.
translations.想再具体求助一下：能否公开每份申请当前是“已收齐、待补正还是复核中”，并保留提交: Would it be possible to make public whether each application is currently “received, pending correction or review” and to maintain a self-checking record of submission? This would at least confirm whether the problem is in the material state or in the sorting results.
translations.我之前发帖也卡在这几项。现在至少能确认通知没公开排序、复核责任、申诉时限和问答机: I've been stuck with them before. At a minimum, it is now possible to confirm that the notice is not publicly sequenced, that the duty to review, the time limit for appeals and the question-and-answer mechanism; this would indicate that the rules are not transparent but cannot be directly established.
translations.我之前提过需要陪伴，这里更想追问承接方式：能不能先提供不必完整复述经历的匿名倾诉: I have mentioned the need for company, and I would like to ask you more about the way in which acceptance takes place: can you first provide an anonymous tip or accompany the entrance without having to repeat the full story? Knowing who to find is more practical than listening to another apology.
translations.我也会担心反馈发出去后就没下文。要是有人亲历或受影响，至少应知道能否私下补充、多: I'm also worried that the feedback will be gone. If a person is personally or has been affected, at least know whether and how long the response can be received in private; otherwise the entrance is less likely to be used.
translations.我也在等这个时间点。要是暂时不能公布完整处置，至少能不能先说由哪个部门承接、什么: I am also waiting for that timeline. If the full handling cannot yet be disclosed, could the school at least say which department is responsible and when it will update everyone? Otherwise people can only keep guessing.
translations.我也想知道处理依据和时间安排。有没有同学愿意一起把学校后续公开信息按时间整理一下: I would also like to know the basis and timing of the process. Would any of you like to join us to sort out some information on the follow-up to the school? Just remember what can be verified to facilitate follow-up.
translations.我也想知道的不只是“会保障”，而是学生如果害怕被认出来，能不能先匿名反馈、得到明: I would also like to know not only that it is “guaranteed”, but that if students are afraid of being recognized, can they first receive anonymous feedback and a clear response? In such cases, who should ordinary students turn to for help?
translations.我也想知道，除了申诉入口，受影响学生当下有没有能联系到的陪伴或情绪支持？别让学生: I would also like to know whether the affected students have any immediate contact with or emotional support, except for the complaints portal. Don't let the students digest themselves and wait for an uncertain follow-up.
translations.我也想确认一个很实际的点：反馈提交后，学生能在哪儿查到回执或处理状态？如果只能等: I also want to confirm something practical: after submitting feedback, where can students check the acknowledgement or case status? If they can only wait for a notice, whom should they contact when no acknowledgement arrives?
translations.我也想问清楚：受影响同学提交反馈后，学校会不会主动联系并告知下一步，而不是还要他: I also want a clear answer: after affected students submit feedback, will the school proactively contact them and explain the next step instead of making them ask repeatedly?
translations.我也担心匿名入口只是“收悉”就结束。至少应说明谁能接触反馈、多久给一次进展；如果: I am also concerned that the anonymous entrance ends with a mere receipt. At the very least, who can access feedback and how often can progress be made; if additional details are required, how can contact not reveal the identity of the student?
translations.我也担心这点。除了说明后续处置，能不能给学生一个不必实名、不会被追问细节的反馈入: I'm worried too. In addition to describing follow-up, could a feedback portal be given to students without a real name and without being asked for details? Otherwise, “welcome statements” would sound empty.
translations.我也更在意这一步：如果有人当场受影响，后续想不想参加类似交流、要不要反馈，都应该: I also care more about this step: if someone is affected on the spot, it is up to me to decide whether or not to engage in similar exchanges or to provide feedback. Could the school first indicate who the students could look for if they wanted help or if they just wanted company?
translations.我也需要确认一个更实际的点：申诉还没答复前，临时住宿申请是按什么条件受理？如果入: I also need to confirm a more practical point: what are the conditions under which a request for temporary accommodation is admissible before a complaint is answered? If the entrance and capacity are not made public, it is difficult for those who lost their election to arrange for the latter residence.
translations.我想知道学校准备怎么给出后续说明：不只是接受道歉，还要让学生知道以后遇到类似情况: I want to know how the school is going to follow up: not only accept an apology, but also let the students know who they can find and how they can guarantee the basic order of communication in the future.
translations.我想确认一个具体支持：补正提交后，能否给申请人一个可核对的状态记录，并在最终结果: I would like to confirm a specific support: will it be possible to provide the applicant with a verifiable status record after the completion of the submission and to distinguish in the final outcome between “materials not completed” and “sorting down”? I need to arrange accommodation for the duration of the study on this basis, and I don't want to keep guessing.
translations.我接受“片段缺少前后语境”这部分纠正，所以不会再把它当逐字原话，更不会据此判断讲: I accept the correction that the clip lacks surrounding context, so I will no longer treat it as a verbatim quote or use it to infer the speaker's motive or career impact. Verification of the wording, rule changes, and job preparation should be considered separately.
translations.我更关心反馈提交后谁来主动联系当事人，以及多久能收到一次进度。能不能先把这两个信: I am more concerned about who will proactively contact the client after the feedback is submitted and how often progress will be received. Can you first clarify these two messages and keep asking them to avoid being affected?
translations.我更在意反馈之后有没有人真正跟着当事学生走完这段，而不只是给个编号。能不能说明会: I'm more concerned about whether, after the feedback, anyone really followed the student, not just a number. Could you indicate who will be in touch and how often will you return to progress? Not to disclose the money, but not to allow those affected to ask themselves.
translations.我更想确认的是：反馈提交后由谁跟进、怎么联系到本人？如果只登记不说明后续，受影响: I would like to confirm more: who will follow up on the feedback and how will I reach myself? If registration is not provided for follow-up, the affected students are still not aware of the outcome of any recourse.
translations.我最怕的是材料交了以后一直没回音，最后才发现缺件或没进复核。能不能先给个受理状态: What I fear most is that after the material was handed over, there was no reply, and it was only then that the missing items were found or not reviewed. Could you give us a status and update? It would be useful to know, at the very least, whether it would be appropriate to prepare a complaint and not to guess the accommodation arrangements.
translations.我比较担心的是，入口公开了但提交后没人接住。能不能说明一下反馈是否有回执、由谁跟: I am more concerned that the entrance was made public but no one picked it up. Could you please indicate if the feedback was received and by whom? It is not necessary to disclose the information of the parties, at least to let those seeking help know that the matter did not fall into a black hole.
translations.我觉得还要补一个实际影响：如果状态只显示“补正中”，大家连什么时候能找替代住宿都: I think there's a real impact to be added: if the state is just a “correction”, we can't even judge when we can find alternative accommodation. At a minimum, the expected nodes of review should be indicated and should not be known until the bed is empty.
translations.我觉得还要问清结果怎么公示：是只公布名单，还是连各类别的排序依据和复核范围也说明: I would also like to know how the results will be publicized: whether the list will be published only or whether the ranking basis and the scope of review for each category will be explained. Otherwise, even with an entry point, the applicant does not know which step to check.
translations.报道和道歉已经足够说明辱骂不是“语境问题”。现在更实际的是，受影响的同学有没有明: Reports and apologies are sufficient to show that verbal abuse is not a “verbal problem”. More practical now is there any clear channels of communication or support for the affected students?
translations.报道和道歉能对上已发生的辱骂，但学校后续处理现在还是空白。有没有公布负责部门和预: Reports and apologies can address the abuse that has occurred, but school follow-up is still blank. Has the responsible department and expected feedback time been published?
translations.报道和道歉能说明辱骂确实发生了，但陪伴不能只停在“有渠道”这句话。有没有一种不用: The reports and apologies show that the abuse did occur, but that the company could not stop with the phrase “there are channels”. Is there a way to get together without repeating the experience in its entirety?
translations.按需求类型做互助匹配这个思路可以，但匹配前能不能说明会展示到哪一级、由谁维护？不: The idea of matching mutual assistance by type of need could be done, but could it be explained at what level and by whom? Otherwise, “same kind of mutual assistance” could be turned into personal data being repeatedly asked.
translations.排序、复核和申诉之外，最好也显示材料是否已完整受理、缺件如何补正。这样申请人能分: In addition to ranking, review and complaints, it would be desirable to indicate whether the material is fully admissible and how the missing items are corrected. This allows the applicant to distinguish between material processing issues and ranking issues that are not allocated.
translations.排序、复核和申诉之外，能不能给每份申请一个受理状态？至少让人知道是已受理、待补材: Can each application be granted a single status, in addition to ranking, review and complaint? At the very least, it is known whether the material has been received, is pending, or has been placed in the order, otherwise the complaint cannot be addressed.
translations.排序、复核和申诉这些都要写清，但没分到床位的人，后续住宿或临时安置方案也该一起说: The ranking, review and complaint should be clear, but those who have not been assigned a bed should be indicated together with the follow-up accommodation or temporary placement programme. Otherwise, even if there was an entrance to the complaint, there was no real idea what to do next.
translations.排序、复核和申诉都要说清。还想问一个更具体的：申请材料里哪些字段会影响同类比较，: Order, review and appeal are clear. A more specific question was also raised: which fields in the application would affect the same kind of comparison, a criterion that could be seen before submission. Otherwise, even if there was an entry point, it would be difficult to judge whether they were assessed on the same scale.
translations.排序、复核和申诉都说清后，公开问答能不能把问题和统一答复留档？不然不同人收到不同: Can questions and answers be left pending after prioritization, review and appeals have been cleared? Otherwise, different people receive different calibres, and it is still impossible to check behind them.
translations.排序、复核和申诉都说清后，材料补交或复核期间能不能查到自己的审核进度？不然最后只: After prioritization, review and appeal have been completed, can the submission or review be followed up with progress? Otherwise, we'll get the results, or we won't know where the card is.
translations.排序依据公开后，还应显示材料是已受理、待补正还是复核中。这样没分到时，至少能分清: When the ranking is made public, it should also indicate whether the material has been received, is pending correction or is under review. When this is not done, at least it is clear whether the material's state is a problem or whether the same sort of ranking is backward.
translations.排序依据和申诉时限之外，能否让申请人查到材料是否已完整受理、缺件如何补正、复核卡: Can the applicant find out whether the material is fully processed, how the missing items are corrected and what steps are being taken to review the card, in addition to the ranking basis and time limit for the complaint? There is a recognizable status portal, which is selected to determine whether it is a sorting or a material handling problem.
translations.排序依据暂时没公开，不等于已经内定；但如果答疑只口头说，后面还是没法核对。公开问: The ranking basis is not made public for the time being and does not amount to an established ranking; however, if the answer is only oral, it is not possible to check it later. Will public questions and answers retain questions, answers and applicable versions?
translations.排序依据能公开当然好，但别让大家公开材料细节。更实用的是给每份申请一个匿名状态：: It would certainly be nice to have a ranking basis for disclosure, but not for details. It would be more useful to give each application an anonymous status: the missing material, the review process or the rule, at least knowing where the card is.
translations.排序依据还没公开前，申诉期间的临时安置也很关键：如果原住宿到期但结果未定，学校准: Prior to disclosure of the ranking basis, temporary placement during the appeal is also crucial: What transition arrangements would schools offer if the original accommodation expired and the results were not determined? At the very least, the person and the manner of application should be indicated.
translations.排序区间和材料状态能减少信息差，但如果同类申请条件接近，最终按什么可核对的依据取: The ranking interval and material status can reduce the information gap, but if the same type of application conditions are close, what are the eventual checks and balances? This part is not public, and it is not possible to judge whether the results are fair.
translations.排序区间能减少信息差，但同类条件接近时，具体按什么材料取舍、由谁留痕确认？这一步: Disparities in information can be reduced by sorting between areas, but when similar conditions are close, what materials are to be selected, and by whom? Without such clarity, the applicant can still only guess the results.
translations.排序区间能查是一步，但落选后到申诉答复前住哪儿也不能靠自己扛。能否公布临时住宿的: The ranking is a step forward, but no place can be left to live on its own until the election is completed. Can the requested entrances, capacity and the person responsible for the temporary accommodation be published?
translations.排序原则和材料状态都公开还不够，同档或条件相近的申请最后怎么取舍，也该留一份匿名: Neither the ranking principle nor the material ' s state of disclosure is sufficient, and an anonymous statement should be left as to the final trade-off between applications with the same filing or similar conditions. Otherwise, you can see the rules, but you still do not know whether border cases have been dealt with uniformly.
translations.排序和同类比较之外，没拿到床位的人在申诉等待期间住哪里、由谁通知临时安排？这个过: In addition to ranking and comparison, where does a person who does not have access to a bed live while his or her complaint is pending and who informs the interim arrangement? This transition programme should also be made clear in advance.
translations.排序和复核怎么做需要说明；那申诉提交后，多久必须给第一次答复？如果只是收件不设时: What is required for ranking and review; how long after the complaint is submitted must the first reply be given? If there is no time limit for receipt, the applicant is still unable to judge whether the issue has been addressed.
translations.排序和复核条件能公开的话，申诉提交后是不是也该说明由谁接收、多久确认材料、多久给: Should the conditions for ranking and review be made public, should the complaint also indicate by whom it was received, how long it was confirmed, and how long it was answered? Otherwise, the applicants would have to wait for the final list.
translations.排序和复核标准确实要说明；但536份申请里没拿到床位的人，学校有没有统一的临时安: The criteria for ranking and review did indeed need to be clarified; however, were there any uniform temporary placement or alternative programmes in schools for those who did not have a bed in 536 applications? This part should also be published.
translations.排序和复核要说清之外，能不能也给有住宿需求的人一个公开互助入口或汇总方式？不然大: In addition to the clarity of the ranking and review, could an open mutual assistance portal or aggregation be provided to persons with accommodation needs? Otherwise, it would be difficult to find the same type of verification and to prepare a complaint, even if one finds itself in a similar situation.
translations.排序和复核规则之外，最后没拿到床位的人有没有明确的替代安置或过渡安排？如果没有，: Are there any clear alternative placements or transitional arrangements for those who have not been finally provided with a bed outside the rules of ranking and review? If not, it is difficult to assess the impact of this allocation on the actual accommodation risk.
translations.排序和复核规则要公开，但别等到最后只发一个结果：申请人至少该知道材料是否齐全、现: The rules for ranking and review are to be made public, but not until the final results are issued: at least the applicant should know whether the material is complete and where the card is now. Otherwise, it is not clear from which date the alleged deadline for filing a complaint will run.
translations.排序和复核规则要公开，但还得说清楚：申诉等待期间，没分到床位的人住哪里、临时安排: The rules on ranking and review should be made public, but it should also be made clear: where does a person who is not assigned to a bed while a complaint is pending and who is responsible for the temporary arrangements? For the final outcome alone, the actual accommodation risk is not met.
translations.排序和复核说清还不够，最后最好放一份匿名化统计：各类申请多少、各类分到多少、未分: The sorting and review were not enough, and it would be preferable to end with an anonymous count: how many applications were, how many were and how many were not. Don't take personal information, but you have to be able to check the results according to the rules.
translations.排序和复核责任已经有人问了，我更想确认：申诉提交后预计多久能收到答复？如果赶不上: Questions have already been asked about the responsibility for sequencing and review, and I would like to confirm more: how long is the expected response after the submission of the complaint? Who will notify the temporary arrangements if they cannot meet the node?
translations.排序和复核都写清后，能不能再明确一个公开问答渠道？如果大家对同一条规则有疑问，最: Can one more open question-and-answer channel be identified once the sequencing and review are completed? If there were any doubts about the same rule, it would be preferable to provide a unified response, otherwise it would be confusing to ask each other.
translations.排序和材料复核之外，申诉截止时间也得明确吧？如果申请人没收到单独提醒，过期责任怎: In addition to sequencing and material review, the deadline for filing a complaint should also be clarified? If the applicant has been confiscated to a single reminder, what is the liability for expiry and who will notify the temporary accommodation?
translations.排序和材料字段说清后，申诉才有核对基础；但如果申诉提交了，具体由哪个岗位或小组负: Once the sequence and material fields had been cleared, there was a basis for checking the complaint; however, if the complaint had been submitted, what function or panel was responsible for responding? Otherwise the entrance would be open and the responsibility would still hang.
translations.排序和材料状态之外，没分到床位后的安置方案会在什么时候公布？如果只是说“另行安排: When will the placement programme, which is not assigned to the bed, be announced outside the sorting and material status? If only “other arrangements” were made, how would the applicant judge in advance whether they would be implemented?
translations.排序和申诉机制要公开，材料标准也别落下。最好同步统一清单和示例，申请人才能按同一: Sequencing and complaint mechanisms should be made public and material standards set aside. It would be preferable to synchronize the checklist and the examples so that applicants could follow the same criteria for self-examination and follow-up review would be more evidence-based.
translations.排序和申诉要说清，审核过程也不能让人两眼一抹黑：至少告诉申请人材料是已受理、待补: The sorting and appeal process should be clear, and the review process should not be discredited: at least the applicant should be informed whether the material has been received, is pending correction or is reviewed, and the missing items should be added to the date. It is impossible to make accommodation arrangements while waiting for the final outcome.
translations.排序和申诉都说清楚后，还需要有个公开问答页吧？谁负责维护、多久更新一次，不然大家: A public question-and-answer page is also needed when the sequence and the complaint are clear? Who is in charge of maintenance and how often they are updated, or else we can only guess each other.
translations.排序字段公开后，复核责任也得能追溯吧？如果只写“综合评估”，申请人申诉时能不能知: After the ranking fields are made public, the duty of review can be traced, too? If only a “comprehensive assessment” was written, could the applicant be aware of which material was checked when he filed his complaint?
translations.排序字段如果申请前公开，提交后能不能看到一份锁定版或留痕？不然规则虽公开，后面改: If the application is made public, can you see a locked version or marks after submission? Otherwise, the rules would be open and the later changes would not be checked.
translations.排序规则、复核和申诉入口都补上后，申请人能不能看到自己适用的类别和排序依据？至少: When the ranking rules, the review and the appeals portal are added, can the applicant see the type and basis of ranking that he or she applies? At the very least, there is a way to check the results, knowing which criteria are to be followed.
translations.排序规则之外，最好给每位申请人一个可查询的材料状态：已受理、待补正还是复核中，并: In addition to the ranking rules, it is advisable to give each applicant a searchable material status: accepted, pending correction or review, and to indicate a completion deadline. This would at least make it clear whether the matter was material or sorted out.
translations.排序规则之外，最好补一条：申请人能查到自己材料是否被完整受理、缺件如何补正。这样: In addition to the ranking rules, it would be preferable for the applicant to be able to find out whether his/her materials were fully processed and how the missing items were corrected. At the very least, this distinguishes between “unlisted” and “materials are not properly processed” and facilitates follow-up to complaints.
translations.排序规则之外，最想确认材料这块：提交清单、收齐时间和补正时间能不能都留痕并可查？: In addition to the sorting rules, this section is the one most interested in confirming the material: can the submission of the inventory, the time of receipt and the time of completion be marked and checked? If the latter rule is adjusted, at least clarify which version of the submitted material should be checked.
translations.排序规则之外，能不能先公布一个统一问答页？这样大家提交材料和申诉时有同一份口径，: In addition to the ranking rules, could a single question and answer page be published? This gives us the same calibre when submitting submissions and complaints and shows which questions have been answered and which questions remain open.
translations.排序规则之外，能不能先说明材料复核的具体方式？我担心申请材料被误读，想知道是否会: Beyond the ranking rules, could you explain exactly how application materials will be reviewed? I am worried that my submission may be misread and want to know whether there will be item-by-item verification or a chance to provide clarification.
translations.排序规则和复核责任说清后，最好也留一个能互相找住宿搭子、交换信息的公开入口；不然: Once the ranking rules and review responsibilities have been clarified, it would also be desirable to have an open entry point where each other can find accommodation and exchange information; otherwise, it will be difficult for those who are not to be assigned to either appeal or find alternatives in a timely manner.
translations.排序规则要公开，但申请状态也不能一直黑箱。至少让人知道材料是待复核、需补交，还是: The ranking rules should be made public, but the status of application should not be kept in black. At the very least, it should be known whether the material is subject to review, has to be submitted, or has already been reviewed, and not just one result.
translations.排序规则还没公开前，匿名编号对应的排序区间和复核变更记录先做起来也行吧？至少能知: Before the ranking rules are made public, how about an anonymous number corresponding to the ranking and review of the change records? At the very least, it is possible to know where the card is, without having to present the application.
translations.支持入口不能只停在“欢迎反馈”。对受影响学生来说，能不能先由固定联系人接住，不要: The support portal cannot stop at “welcome feedback”. For the affected students, can they first be taken by a permanent contact, without having to repeat the whole story before deciding how to follow up on the feedback?
translations.支持入口不该只停在“有渠道”这句话，最好说明怎么联系、是否能匿名，以及大概多久能: Support for access should not be confined to the phrase “there are channels”, preferably indicating how to reach, whether to be anonymous and, perhaps, how long to respond. This means that the students present do not have to explain their experiences.
translations.支持入口的首次回应时限确实很关键。还想知道联系后是否会有固定跟进人，至少不用每次: The time frame for the first response in support of the portal is indeed crucial. It would also be interesting to know whether there would be a permanent follow-up person after the contact, at least without repeating the experience every time; this could also be explained before formal disposition was concluded.
translations.支持渠道已经登记不等于受影响同学能得到帮助吧？有没有人知道实际怎么反馈、多久会收: Support channels have been registered, which does not mean that affected students can be helped? Does anyone know how the feedback actually came and how long it's gonna take?
translations.支持渠道很重要，但不一定要等学校先给结论；如果有在场或受影响的同学想找人互相确认: Support channels are important, but they do not have to wait for the school to come to conclusions; if there are students present or affected who want to identify their experiences with each other, I would like to comb them together and not leave them alone.
translations.支持渠道最好不只说“欢迎反馈”，能不能明确到匿名入口和陪伴联系人？不想把经历讲完: Would it be preferable for support channels to go beyond “welcome feedback” and to identify anonymous entry points and accompanying contacts? Those who do not want to complete their experiences should be helped first.
translations.支持渠道这点很重要。最好把“不用先完整复述经过”写成明确做法，而不是只说有咨询入: Support channels are important. It would be preferable to have “no full restatement” as a clear practice, rather than simply a reference point; it would also be useful to give a point of time for follow-up feedback, without students having to keep guessing.
translations.收到回执，但这只说明进了队列，不等于材料已经被复核。48小时内能否明确逐项核对哪: A reply was received, but this does not mean that the material has been reviewed. Could it be clear, within 48 hours, which material would be checked on a case-by-case basis, how the admissibility records would be identified, and whether missing or additional items would be identified separately?
translations.收到回执，至少确认材料进了队列；但还需要能查到“缺件/待复核/已出结果”的状态，: Replies were received confirming, at least, that the material was queued; however, the status of “missing/pending review/results” and the item-by-case reconciliation of records were also required. Within 48 hours, the applicant was unable to determine whether the material was correctly understood if it was only updated and without a basis for review.
translations.整理时能不能顺手标出学校后续安排的更新时间和原文链接？这样大家能区分已公布内容和: When compiling the information, could you also include the update time and original link for the school's follow-up arrangements? That would help everyone distinguish published information from pending action without repeatedly relying on secondhand accounts.
translations.既然不该让受影响同学反复自证，那反馈接住之后，谁来主动告知进度？总不能还得他们自: If affected students should not have to prove themselves repeatedly, who will proactively update them after their feedback is received? They should not still have to chase answers again and again.
translations.既然可以不先复述经过，能不能再明确一个具体承接人或同伴安排？学生只说“需要陪伴”: Since students need not recount what happened first, could a specific contact person or peer arrangement also be identified? After a student says 'I need accompaniment,' clarify who will reach out and how far the support extends instead of leaving them to navigate it alone.
translations.更新时间和预计时限确实该有。再补一个容易被漏掉的：申诉还没答复时，临时住宿怎么安: The time frame for updating and the projected time frame should indeed be there. One more could easily be missed: when a complaint is pending, how, where and where to find temporary accommodation must be clearly summarized, otherwise there is no place to live.
translations.最好能直接给每份申请一个可保存的受理编号，显示材料是否齐全、现在由谁复核、下一次: It would be useful to provide each application with a single preservation number indicating whether the material is complete, who is now reviewing it and the next update. The missing items would be filled in a timely manner and would not be left untreated until the results were available.
translations.最怕的不是名额少，是问了也没人答、只能一直等。除了受理状态，最好把集中问答和统一: It's not a small number, it's no answer, it's just waiting. In addition to the status of admissibility, it would be preferable to clarify the focus on questions and answers and the timing of the responses; otherwise, the lack of information, the sorting of information, could lead to increased anxiety.
translations.最憋屈的就是“优先考虑”这几个字，申请人连自己按哪套材料、排在哪个档都不知道，申: The words “priority” are the words most suffocated, and the applicant does not even know the type of material he/she uses or the level of his/her placement on, nor does he/she have access to the complaint. At the very least, the version of the material used and the deadline for appeals should be made public.
translations.最憋屈的就是结果可能有客观限制，但材料被谁看、错了找谁改都不说，申请人只能干等。: The most suffocating is that the outcome may be objectively limited, but the material is seen and wrongly sought, and the applicant can only wait. It can't be said that there is a box, but this feeling of non-checkability is really damaging.
translations.最憋屈的确实是被卡在黑箱里：床位少还能理解，但不知道自己缺哪项、排在哪、找谁复核: It is true that the most suffocated is in the black box: the less the bed, the less the bed, the less it is, the less the place it is, the less it is, the less it is, the more it is, the more it is. Do not take the word “incorporate” as a conclusion, but the notice is indeed not reassuring.
translations.最憋闷的就是材料到底卡在哪儿都不知道。缺件清单、补正截止和补交后的状态如果不留痕: The most suffocating thing is that they don't know where they are. If the list of missing items, the cut-off date and the post-off date are not marked, no one will be able to determine whether the material was not filled or whether the order was in the background.
translations.最憋闷的就是：就算没证据说内定，申请人连复核找谁、多久能收到答复都不知道。规则不: The most stifling is that, even if there is no evidence to suggest otherwise, the applicant does not know who he is to review and how long he will receive his reply. The lack of transparency in the rules is enough to make people think less.
translations.最让人不安的是，申诉等结果这段时间如果没地方住，谁来兜底？规则不透明已经够憋屈了: Most disturbingly, if there is no place to live during the period of the complaint, who will go to the bottom? The lack of transparency of the rules is enough, and temporary accommodation cannot be considered a personal issue for the applicant.
translations.最让人难受的是，申诉结果没出来前这段时间也是真实的住宿风险。临时住宿如果只是口头: Most painfully, the period before the outcome of the complaint was also a real residential risk. If the temporary accommodation is merely an oral “connection”, the application for entry, the responsible party and the time point are not clear, and the applicant can still wait.
translations.最难受的其实是提交完像把材料扔进黑箱：到底缺件、待复核，还是已经按规则落选，申请: The most painful is the fact that the material was placed in the black box after the submission: it was missing, pending review, or it had been rejected by the rules, which the applicant did not know. Let's at least give you a check-in and a update, and let's not just guess.
translations.最难受的就是卡在“等通知”：如果补材料也没有明确截止，错过到底算谁的？先把每份申: The hardest part is stuck in a “waiting notice”: who is missing if the completion is not clear? The status of receipt, the items to be filled and the deadline for each application should be clarified, at least not to be guessed.
translations.最难受的就是连“什么时候能问、问谁”都没有。就算最后不是内定，落选的人也不能只收: The hardest part is not even “when and by whom”. Even if it did not end up being internal, the person who lost the election could not have received a single result, at least with a clear time limit for responding to the complaint.
translations.最难受的是落选前后都像在猜：材料有没有收齐、缺件能不能补、到底卡在受理还是排序。: The worst is the fact that before and after the election, it was like guessing whether or not the material was received, whether or not the missing items could be filled, whether or not they were being processed or ranked. If this state of affairs is not clear, it is easy to exhale anxiety into “internal” speculation.
translations.最难受的是落选后像被关在黑箱外：现在连申诉入口和答复时限都没有，大家当然会越猜越: The worst part is that after losing the election, it looks like being locked out of the box: now there is no entry to the complaint and no time limit for reply, and of course people get more and more suspicious. Let's put these two on the table, at least let's not have no place to ask.
translations.最难受的确实不是床位少，而是交了材料之后像被丢进黑箱：到底收没收齐、排到哪一步、: It is true that the worst part is not the small number of beds, but the fact that the materials are handed over and thrown into the black box: where, where, and who is looking, the applicant depends on guesses. If there is no evidence, do not wear the “inline” hat, but the failure itself is enough to be disturbing.
translations.有“已收悉”不等于匿名真的安全吧？回执能不能说明反馈由谁接收、原渠道是否看得到？: Having a "received" doesn't mean it's really safe to be anonymous. Could the reply indicate who received the feedback and whether the original channels were visible? Otherwise, students are afraid to submit.
translations.有匿名入口只是开始，学校还得说明谁来接、怎么持续跟进。让受影响的学生一次次复述经: The anonymous entrance is only the beginning, and the school has to indicate who is to pick up and how to follow up. It is an additional burden to allow affected students to repeat their experiences over and over again.
translations.有匿名状态能知道卡在哪一步，但如果最终只显示“按规则落选”，申请人还是没法判断自: Anonymity gives an idea of where the card is going, but the applicant is still unable to judge where he or she ranks in the same category if it is eventually shown only as a “ruled failure”. Can the applicable categories, key comparators and individual ranking be at least informed?
translations.有反馈入口还不够，最好说明由谁接收、是否能匿名，以及反馈后会不会有回执；不然学生: It is not enough to have a feedback portal to indicate who receives it, whether it is anonymous and whether there will be a response to the feedback; otherwise, the student does not know who to look for.
translations.有反馈或求助渠道还不够，能不能明确谁会接、多久有回音？受影响同学至少该知道自己不: There was not enough feedback or recourse, so could it be clear who would answer it and how long? At the very least, the affected students should know that they are not speaking out.
translations.有回执不等于有人接住了。受辱的人如果还得自己反复追问、证明自己受了影响，真的会很: There's a reply that doesn't mean someone caught it. It would be exhausting for the humiliated to have to ask themselves repeatedly and prove that they have been affected; at least to indicate if there has been any follow-up, rather than turning “registered” into a stop.
translations.有回执只是收到，不代表学生真的敢说、说了也会被认真处理。至少该把反馈入口和后续联: The fact that the reply was received does not mean that the student would have said or said it would have been taken seriously. At the very least, feedback portals and follow-up contacts should be made clear, and those affected should not be left to themselves.
translations.有回执只是知道材料没丢，不代表受影响的人真的被接住了。能否说明有没有持续陪伴或跟: An acknowledgement only shows that the submission was not lost; it does not mean the affected person has truly received support. Is someone assigned to provide continuing accompaniment or follow-up so they do not have to explain and ask repeatedly?
translations.有回执确实不等于解决。若学校还没公布专门入口，至少应说明学生向谁反馈、多久能收到: A reply does not really mean a solution. If a special entrance has not yet been announced, at the very least, it should indicate to whom the student gives feedback and how long it will be received, so that those affected do not search for it themselves.
translations.有回执至少说明反馈没被直接丢掉，但受理不等于学生已经得到支持。能不能说明反馈会不: A receipt at least shows that the feedback was not discarded, but acceptance does not mean students have received support. Can you explain whether feedback can remain anonymous and who will protect students from being humiliated again?
translations.有联系人和回复时限是一步，但如果受影响同学不方便持续追问，学校会不会主动确认他们: Contacts and response time limits are a step, but if the affected students are not able to follow up on them on a continuous basis, will the school be willing to confirm whether they need support? Otherwise, it's easy to become students themselves.
translations.有联系人和进度回执是必要的，但回执本身怎么证明事情真的在推进？能不能说明匿名反馈: Contacts and progress confirmations are necessary, but how can they prove that things are moving forward? Would it be possible to indicate who would follow up anonymously, rather than merely confirming receipt?
translations.有联系人还不够，学校能不能明确下一次回执的时间？别让受影响的同学还得自己一次次追: Having a contact person is not enough. Can the school specify when the next update will come? Affected students should not have to keep asking; someone should follow up proactively.
translations.服务队列里有回执，但这算不算真正能让受影响同学安心反馈？有没有人收到过具体回应，: There's a reply in the service line, but does that really give the affected students a sense of comfort? Have any specific responses been received or are only confirmations of “receipts received” at this time?
translations.材料复核后，申请人能看到自己的排序位置或至少所属档位吗？不必公开个人材料，但如果: After the materials are reviewed, can the applicant see his or her sorting position or at least his or her slot? It is not necessary to disclose personal data, but it is not possible to check the rankings if only “passed/failed” are received.
translations.材料复核责任人说清还不够，同一类别里到底按什么依据取舍？如果只是“综合评估”，申: It is not enough for those responsible for the material review to state that there is a trade-off in the same category. If only a “comprehensive assessment”, how does the applicant check that his or her material is compared by the same standard?
translations.材料复核这块还应说清：如果缺材料或材料不被采信，是否会先通知申请人补正、说明原因: The review of the material should also make clear that, if the missing material or material is not accepted, the applicant will be notified of the correction and the reasons for it. Otherwise, even if the ranking was made public, the results would be difficult to check.
translations.材料复核这点影响很实际：同样的情况，如果没人说明按什么标准认定，申请人连自己被怎: The review of the material has practical implications: in the same case, the applicant does not know even how he/she is understood, if no one has explained what criteria he/she uses. At the very least, the basis for the review and whether the results of the review can be examined should be made public; this can only improve the reconciliation and does not justify a fair distribution.
translations.材料字段和合格示例公开后，结果出来能不能再让申请人核对自己的复核记录？不必公开他: When material fields and qualified examples are made public, can the result be that the applicant can again verify his or her review record? It is not necessary to disclose other people ' s materials, but at least it should be possible to see which fields are used, whether they are missing or whether they are entering errors.
translations.材料完整受理、缺件补正这点很关键。那申请人能不能在提交后看到“已受理/待补正/复: It is critical that the material be fully processed and that the missing items be corrected. Can the applicant see a state of “admissible/pending correction/review” after submission? Otherwise, it would be impossible to determine whether the material was not on the line or not.
translations.材料完整受理和缺件补正很关键。能不能再明确：申请人何时能看到自己的审核状态，补件: The completeness of the material and the completeness of the missing documents are crucial. Can it be any clearer when the applicant will be able to see his or her own audit status and how long will it be updated? Those in need of accommodation may also seek similar assistance as soon as possible, without waiting for the final outcome.
translations.材料完整受理这点很关键。那申请人能不能看到自己的材料已受理、待补正还是复核中？如: The integrity of the material is crucial. Can the applicant see that his/her material has been processed, is pending correction or is under review? If they are missing, the completion deadline should also be indicated together.
translations.材料展示到哪一级确实要先说清；我还特别怕补完材料后又没下文，能不能明确“补正提交: At what level does the material appear to be clear-cut; I am particularly afraid that after completion of the material, there will be no follow-up, so that it will be clear that “the status of review will be updated within a few days of the submission”, otherwise people will remain on hold, and the anxiety is really high.
translations.材料收齐和补正时间能留痕很关键。那最终排序时，能不能同时显示采用的材料版本和对应: It is critical that the time when materials are collected and corrected leaves a mark. Can the final sorting be accompanied by the use of the version of the material and the corresponding sequence basis? Otherwise, it's still hard to check.
translations.材料显示“待复核”也不够呀，申诉入口和答复时限总得给个明确说法吧？不然大家只能一: The material shows that “waiting review” is not enough, so does the appeal entry and the response time limit always have to be clear? Otherwise, we'll have to wait until we find out who to follow.
translations.材料有没有被完整受理确实得能查，但我还想追问一句：同一类别内部准备按哪些条件排？: It is true that the material has been fully processed, but I would also like to ask: what are the conditions to be followed within the same category? If only categories were published and no verifiable criteria were published, the “admissible” finding was still unknown.
translations.材料有没有被看见、现在卡在哪一步，真的不能靠申请人自己猜。没有状态记录的话，落选: Whether or not the material was seen and where the card is now, cannot really be guessed by the applicant. Without a status record, it would be hard enough to lose the election, even if the complaint was speaking to the air.
translations.材料清单只是第一步，最好连“这次排序采用了哪版材料、当前属于哪个档位、申诉截止到: The list of materials is only the first step, and it would be preferable to see it on the application page, even if it reads “what version of the material is used for this sorting, which slot is currently in, and which date the complaint is due”. Otherwise, the supplements and the objections are like the blind.
translations.材料清单和合格示例能解决缺件问题，但同类排序还差一步：复核时具体看哪些材料字段、: The list of materials and the list of eligible examples can solve the problem of missing items, but the sort of ranking is still one step behind: Which material fields were specifically looked at during the review and could the applicant check them before the outcome?
translations.材料清单和排序依据能查的话，申诉期间的状态变化也会不会留痕并可回看？不然补交或复: Will the list of materials and their sequencing be traceable and reminiscent, if any, of the changes in status during the complaint? It would be difficult to determine which step to update after a referral or review.
translations.材料清单和更新时间之外，公开问答也应保留问题、答复及适用版本；这样补正和申诉时才: In addition to the list of materials and the time of their updating, questions and answers should be kept in public, as well as answers and the applicable versions; this would allow for the assessment of whether the calibre has changed or not.
translations.材料清单和更新时间如果能看到，确实更好核对。那提交后是否也应保留一份可下载的回执: The inventory of materials and the timing of updates are indeed better checked if they are visible. translations.材料版本留痕很有用，但还想问一步：能否让申请人看到自己当前采用的材料版本、排序档: The material version was useful, but one step was also asked: could the applicant see the version of the material that he was currently using, the sorting slot and the deadline for filing a complaint? translations.材料状态分开标注，确实能让人先核对是不是待补正或还在复核；但它只能说明流程走到哪: The separate marking of the material does allow for a first check of whether it is to be corrected or is still under review; however, it can only indicate where the process is going and not how it is ranked between the three categories and within the same category. translations.材料状态和排序分开很有用；但我还需要能下载或核对“已收齐”对应的材料清单及更新时: The separation of material status and sequencing is useful; however, I need to be able to download or check the list of “collected” corresponding materials and the timing of updates. translations.材料状态和排序分开确实更好；我之前说过规则不清会影响判断材料是否被正确理解，这里: It is indeed better to separate the material from the sequence; I said earlier that the lack of clarity of the rules affects the correct understanding of the material and adds here a practical experience: it would be preferable for the status page to include a list of the materials received and the time of their updating so that the applicant can see whether the correction is actually under review.

translations.材料状态最好不只显示“复核中”，还应注明缺哪项、何时更新；同时能否在不泄露隐私的: It would be preferable if the material were not merely “reviewed”, but also to indicate which items were missing and when they were updated; and could a safe match-up be made for those with accommodation needs, without disclosing their privacy?
translations.材料状态最好也能让申请人自己查到：已受理、待补正、复核中分别是什么，缺件补正截止: It would also be desirable for the material to be available to the applicant for his or her own information as to what was received, which was pending correction, which was reviewed and which date was due. translations.材料状态最好再加上补正截止和当前缺哪项。否则想找同类互助的人，也分不清是还在复核: Material status should preferably be added to the cut-off and which items are currently missing. translations.材料状态最好和排序结果分开显示：已收齐、待补正、复核中、已完成。这样申请人至少知: The optimal state of the material and the results of the sequencing show that it has been received, is awaiting correction, is under review, and has been completed. translations.材料状态最好能留痕，比如已收齐、待补正、复核中，并写清补正截止时间。这样没分到时: It would be preferable to leave marks in the material ' s state, such as those collected, pending correction, under review, and to write the completion deadline. translations.材料状态最好还能对应到具体缺哪一项，不然只显示“待补正”还是没法及时处理。能否给: It is desirable that the material's state should also correspond to the specific missing item, otherwise it would indicate only “to be completed” or not being processed in a timely manner. translations.材料状态有了还不够，复核到底由谁负责、申诉后多久必须答复？这两个时间和责任点不写: The material situation was insufficient, and who was responsible for the review, and how long after the complaint had to be answered? Those two points of time and responsibility were not clear, and no one could compare them.
translations.材料状态有了还不够，复核到底由谁负责也得说清吧。一直卡在“复核中”却找不到对应的: It is not enough for the material to be in such a state that it should be clear who is responsible for the review. People's anxiety is really getting higher when they are stuck in a “review” without finding a match.
translations.材料状态能查之外，最好再显示对应排序档位或缺项说明；这样才能区分“材料未核完”和: In addition to the material status check, it would be preferable to display a description of the corresponding sorting slots or missing items; this would make a distinction between “materials not nuanced” and “actually placed behind”. translations.材料状态能查很重要。那公开问答是只口头回复，还是会把问题、答复和适用版本留在页面: It is important that the material's state is checked. translations.材料状态能查确实很重要，不然人会一直悬着，把“缺件”误当成“落选”。但补正后也要: The verification of material status is indeed important, otherwise people will remain on hold and mistook “deficient” as “lost”. translations.材料状态能查还不够吧，申请人确认提交完整后，复核方是否也要标明“已核对哪些字段”: The status of the material is not sufficient, and once the applicant has confirmed that it has been submitted in its entirety, should the reviewing party also indicate “what fields have been checked”? translations.材料状态能看出补正卡在哪，但还看不出排序依据。申诉后再给一个明确答复时限，至少大: The material status indicates where the completion card is located, but the basis for ranking is not clear. translations.材料状态能看到只是第一步，申诉也得写清由谁接、多久答复、逾期怎么办。不然申请人知: The status of the material can be seen as a first step, and the complaint must be written by whom, how long and what to do with the delay. Otherwise, the applicant knows where the card is and still does not know when it will be verifiable.
translations.材料状态能看见了，但申诉提交后有没有受理确认？不然申请人怎么知道申诉已进入处理，: The material is visible, but has the complaint been confirmed after submission? Otherwise, how does the applicant know that the complaint is in the process of being processed and not just on the submission page?
translations.材料状态能让人核对流程有没有卡住，但我之前提到的补正期限也一样，不能替代排序规则: The condition of the material allows the process to be checked if it is stuck, but the same time frame, which I mentioned earlier, is not a substitute for the ranking rule. In particular, when similar conditions are close, it is necessary to indicate, at a minimum, which material can be checked for trade-offs, otherwise only the results can be guessed.
translations.材料要求也该配公开问答，不然申请人连“缺哪项、怎么补”都不知道。问答记录和统一口: The material request should also be accompanied by an open question and answer, otherwise the applicant would not even know “what is missing and how to fix it”. Question-and-answer records and common calibres help to check notifications, and do not imply proof of who should have access to the bed.
translations.材料进了黑箱真的很折磨人，但光有“待复核”也不够。能不能同时告知缺件、当前排序依: It's a real torture to have materials in the box, but it's not enough to have “waiting review”. Can the missing items be informed at the same time, the basis for the current ranking and the expected update time? Otherwise, we'll have to wait.
translations.查到材料在哪一步还不够，复核或申诉提交后，能不能明确承诺一个答复时限？不然大家没: What steps, if any, have not been sufficient, and can a clear commitment be made to a time limit for responding after a review or complaint has been submitted? Otherwise, no one can arrange for any follow-up accommodation.
translations.查到材料在哪一步还不够，最后最好给一份匿名化的受理、补正和排序结果统计：不用暴露: It was not enough to find out what step the material was, and it would be preferable to end up with an anonymous intake, correction and ranking statistics: no personal information was to be disclosed, but at least it was clear that the rules had been applied consistently.
translations.正式处置可以等核对后再说，但学生支持和下一次更新时间没必要一起等。至少先把现成入: The formal disposition can wait for verification, but student support does not have to wait together with the next update. translations.状态分开还不够，能不能同步显示已收材料清单和最后更新时间？不然申请人没法确认到底: The separation of status is not sufficient, so can the list of received materials and the timing of the final update be synchronized? Otherwise, the applicant could not confirm which one was missing, nor could the latter claim be substantiated.
translations.状态分得再清楚，如果申请人发现材料状态没更新，具体找谁确认、多久必须回应？这个责: The status is more clear, and if the applicant finds that the material is not updated, who will confirm it and how long will it be necessary to respond? This responsibility window has to be written.
translations.状态可查之外，受理记录最好也能保留可下载或可截图的凭据吧？不然状态后来变了，申请: In addition to being verifiable, it would be desirable for the records to retain downloadable or amplifiable evidence? translations.状态可查是底线，但申诉等结果这段空档也不能没人管。替代住宿信息由谁汇总、多久更新: The state of affairs is the bottom line, but the gap between the outcome and the complaint cannot be left unattended. translations.状态可查询能区分流程走到哪一步，但结果出来后，申请人能不能看到自己的材料核对记录: The status can be searched to distinguish between the steps of the process, but once the results are available, can the applicant see his/her material reconciliation records and applicable fields? translations.状态和更新时间能查很重要，但同类比较用哪些字段，能不能在申请前就公开？不然即使显: It is important that status and update times are checked, but what fields are used for comparison and can they be made public before application? translations.状态回执只能说明材料到哪一步，不能解释为什么有人排前面。学校准备怎么让申请人核对: A status reply would only indicate the step to be taken and would not explain why someone was at the front. How is the school going to allow applicants to check their classification and the basis for comparison?
translations.状态回执和更新时间能让人核对材料有没有被收进系统，但它证明不了排序公平。排序依据: The status check and update time allows for verification of whether the material has been incorporated into the system, but it does not prove fair ranking. translations.状态查询和互助匹配最好分开，别让个人材料暴露在找同伴的帖子里。能不能再说明补正后: Status queries and mutual aid matching should preferably be separated and personal data should not be exposed to a peer search post. translations.状态查询最好和住宿互助匹配分开：申请人至少能确认自己是否待补材料、已完成或待复核: The status check is best separated from the accommodation assistance matching: the applicant can at least confirm whether he or she is awaiting completion, completion or review before deciding whether to find a companion or substitute accommodation. translations.状态标出来还不够，能不能让申请人直接核对自己提交的材料清单和更新时间？这样才知道: (a) Is the status indicator not sufficient to allow applicants to check their submissions directly and for updates? This is the way to know if it's missing, whether it's due or whether it's in order.

translations.状态能查还不够，材料被补正后，系统能不能保留提交和修改时间？不然申请人怎么证明自: Can the system keep the time for submission and modification after the material has been corrected? Otherwise, how can the applicant prove that he or she has completed the materials by the deadline?
translations.状态记录和排序档位如果能查就好多了。那申诉期间如果还没出结果，入住安排会不会先留: It would be much better if status records and sorting slots were checked. If no results had been achieved during the appeal period, would the accommodation arrangement leave an ad hoc and verifiable solution?
translations.状态页列材料清单和更新时间很关键；再补一个实际需求：补正提交后能否生成回执，标明: The list of material on the status page and the timing of the update are crucial; one more practical requirement is added: can a reply be generated after the submission is completed, indicating the version received and the time of entry for review?
