translations.现在最需要的是把排序规则和复核流程说清楚：三类需求怎么排、同类按什么标准比、材料: What is most needed is clarity about the ranking rules and the review process: what are the three types of requirements, what are the criteria for matching them, and who reviews the material? If the application is rejected, the complaint entry and the time limit for reply should also be announced, otherwise no one can prepare.
translations.现在能确认的是320张床位对应536份有效申请，不能据此断言有人内定。通知至少应: It is now possible to confirm that 320 beds correspond to 536 valid applications, on the basis of which it cannot be asserted that there is an internality. The notification should be supplemented by a ranking rule of at least three types of requirements, how the same type of material is compared, who is responsible for the review, as well as the entry and response time frame; otherwise, it is difficult for the person receiving the result to judge whether or not the complaint should have been filed.
translations.现在能确认的是议题和争议外溢，具体原话、现场语境及处理结果还不清楚。评价职业选择: What can currently be confirmed is the issue and the spillover of the dispute; the exact words, on-site context, and handling outcome are still unclear. Before judging career choices, these scopes should be separated so that one person's experience is not presented as a general rule.
translations.现在还是没看到正式处置和反馈的时间点。学校能不能至少说明预计何时更新？不然学生没: There is still no time point for formal disposal and feedback. Could the school at least indicate when it is expected to be renewed? Otherwise the students can't judge whether this is a follow-up or just an apology.
translations.现场辱骂不能被道歉盖过去，这点已经很明确了。那学校后续会不会说明受影响学生能得到: It was clear that verbal abuse on the ground could not be covered by an apology. Will the school follow-up indicate what support is available to the affected students and by which department?
translations.现场辱骂本身已经确认，道歉不能替代后续保障。学校准备怎么让学生反馈时不用担心再次: The abuse itself confirmed that an apology was not a substitute for a follow-up guarantee. How is the school going to get feedback from students without fear of being repressed again?
translations.现阶段仅确认床位缺口及程序信息不完整，院系偏袒、先到先得等说法未证实。请在治理公: At this stage, only the gaps in bed space and incomplete information on procedures are identified, and claims of favouritism and first-come, first-served are not confirmed. Please publish the three types of requirements, categories and similar rankings, the required materials and the outstanding matters in the standard locations of the governance bulletin; review the update within three working days of the announcement by the head of accommodation governance.
translations.生效时间和补材料口径要写清；另外能否让申请人看到自己的材料版本是否被更新、对应哪: The time of entry into force and the calibre of the supplement should be clarified; could the applicant also see whether the version of his or her material had been updated and to which sorting slot? Otherwise, complaints can only be based on results.
translations.申诉入口和答复时限确实该补，但我更怕的是：答复没下来，原住宿先到期，申请人这段时: It is true that the appeals entry and the time limit for reply should be added, but I am even more afraid that the response will not come down, that the original accommodation will expire, and where does the applicant live during this period? Orders can continue to be checked, and transitional arrangements cannot keep people frozen.
translations.申诉有编号和期限是关键，不然“留痕”只停在材料端。再补一条：逾期未答复时，谁能接: The numbering and duration of the complaint is crucial, otherwise the “striking” will stop at the end of the material. One more article: Who can take over or upgrade when the response is overdue? There is no need to guess whether or not there is favouritism.
translations.申诉期间不能只显示“复核中”然后让人自己扛。至少要说清临时住宿由谁衔接、什么时候: The complaint cannot be made “under review” alone and then be carried out on its own. At the very least, it should be clear who will connect the temporary accommodation and when it can be requested; final sequencing is transparent and cannot replace security arrangements for this period.
translations.申诉期间如果原住宿先到期，临时安置具体覆盖哪些人？申请入口和最晚答复时间也得先说: Which persons are specifically covered by temporary placements during the period of the complaint if the original accommodation expires first? The application entrance and the response time at the latest must also be clear, otherwise there will be no place to stay until the order has been cleared.
translations.申诉期间的临时住宿不能只写“另行安排”。要说清申请条件、可住多久、由谁确认；不然: Temporary accommodation during a complaint cannot be written only as “other arrangements”. The terms of the application, the length of stay and who would confirm it; otherwise, the person would have been forced to move in and out of the country without a response.
translations.申诉期间的临时住宿由谁负责安排？如果答复时限内一直没床位，是否先提供过渡住宿，还: Who is responsible for arranging temporary accommodation during the complaint? If there is no bed within the time limit of the response, would transitional accommodation be provided first, or would the applicant be left at his or her own expense?
translations.申诉期间的住宿状态由哪个渠道通知、多久更新一次？如果临时安置有变化，申请人能不能: Which channels are notified of the state of accommodation during the complaint and how often are it updated? In the event of a change in temporary placement, could the applicant receive a clear reminder rather than repeat it?
translations.申诉等待期间的住宿不能靠申请人自己扛。至少要说明临时住哪里、谁来对接、多久给答复: Accommodation while the complaint is pending cannot be borne by the applicant. At the very least, indicate where the temporary residence is, who answers and how long it is to respond; otherwise, even if the order is made public, the person who did not reach the bed is still on hold.
translations.申诉结果出来前，临时住宿不能只停在“会衔接”这句。至少得说明申请从哪里进、谁负责: Pending the outcome of the complaint, the temporary accommodation could not be confined to the phrase “connection”. At the very least, it is necessary to indicate where the application came from, who was responsible for receiving it and when the response was received at the latest, otherwise the risk of the waiting period would fall on the applicant.
translations.申诉编号和期限有了还不够，最好能查到“已受理/待补正/复核中/已答复”这类进度；: The number and duration of the complaint were not sufficient, and it would be useful to find progress in such areas as “admissible/pending correction/reviewed/received”; it should be clear to whom to transfer over time, and should not be repeated.
translations.申诉还没答复时，临时住宿由谁确认资格？如果只能去某个窗口问，能不能先说明联系人或: Who would qualify for temporary accommodation when the complaint remained unanswered? If you can only go to one window, can you first indicate the contact person or the query entry, so that you do not get stuck with the “state submitted” step?
translations.申诉还没答复时，原住宿到期的人能不能先保留床位或申请临时安置？如果这段空档没人负: If the complaint is still pending, can the person whose original accommodation expired retain a bed or apply for temporary placement? If no one is responsible for this gap, transparent ranking may also shift the risk to the applicant.
translations.申诉还没答复时，现住安排会不会先被终止？这点要单独说清，不然入口公开了，人还是可: Will the current residence arrangement be terminated when the complaint remains unanswered? This should be made clear in isolation, otherwise the entrance is open and people may not have a place to live.
translations.申诉还没结果时，临时住宿到底怎么申请、由谁确认资格？如果只是说会衔接，遇到今晚就: When the complaint is pending, how does temporary accommodation apply and who confirms eligibility? If it's just to connect, can you give an implementable temporary solution to someone who has no place to live tonight?
translations.申诉进度能查只是半条链，关键是入住节点前还没答复怎么办：临时安排的触发条件和通知: The progress of the complaint is only half a chain, and the key is that there is no answer before the nodal point: the trigger conditions for the interim arrangement and the duty of notification must be stated, otherwise the status indicates that the “review” is still to wait.
translations.申请状态之外，补正通知也最好能留一份可查询记录，写清缺哪项、何时补齐。否则最后没: In addition to the status of the application, it would also be desirable to leave a searchable record of what is missing and when it will be completed. Otherwise, it was not clear whether the material had not been fully processed or whether it had been placed back in order.
translations.申请进度和排序依据要透明，没分到床位后的安置也不能只停在原则表述：具体方案什么时: The application process and sequencing is based on transparency and cannot rest on the statement of principle without being assigned to a bed: when will the specific programme be published and who will implement it?
translations.登记工单不等于事情有了着落。回复时限可以有，但更关键的是受影响同学能不能知道后续: The registration of the work orders does not mean that things are going down. The response time frame may be available, but it is more crucial that the affected students know who to follow up and who to look for if they need help.
translations.看到“别让大家各自硬扛”这句真的很难受。倾听窗口只是入口，受影响的人还需要能互相: It's really hard to see the phrase “Don't let everyone take it personally”. The listening window is only an entry point, and those affected need to be able to find each other and follow them up on a continuous basis; otherwise, apologies and feedback are like pushing pressure back to the students themselves.
translations.看到“别让大家各自硬扛”这句，心里还是堵得慌。被当众这样对待的人，之后可能连回到: Reading 'do not leave everyone to endure this alone' still hurts. People treated this way in public may later find even returning to class difficult. Having someone listen is only the beginning; do not make them prove that pain themselves.
translations.看到“已收悉”却不知道后面有没有人真正跟进，真的会让受影响的人更孤单。道歉不能自: Seeing 'received' without knowing whether anyone will truly follow up can make affected people feel even more alone. An apology cannot automatically erase the harm; at least do not make them prove repeatedly that they were affected.
translations.看到“怎么排、谁复核、去哪申诉”这些都没写，真的会越等越慌。名额少还能理解，最难: Seeing that the words “how, who reviews and where to go” are not written, it really gets worse. It was hard to understand the small number of places, and the hardest part was to get the results without even knowing why they had not been allocated.
translations.看到“道歉不等于影响自动消失”这句还是很难受。被当众这样对待的人，不该还要自己证: It was difficult to see the phrase “an apology does not mean that it automatically disappears”. Those who have been treated in public should not have to prove themselves how serious this is; at least they should not be left alone after the fact.
translations.看到这句还是挺难受的，已经被辱骂的同学不需要先替对方补全语境。至少先承认这件事确: It's hard to see it, and the abused classmates don't have to fill the gap. At least admit that it did hurt, and hope that those affected would not be allowed to digest themselves.
translations.看见了辱骂已经被报道和道歉支持，就别再让受影响的学生承担“证明自己受伤”的成本了: When verbal abuse is supported by reports and apologies, the affected students are not allowed to bear the cost of “prove their injuries”. If the official disposition of the school has not yet been announced, at least the contact person who has direct access to it should be clear.
translations.真的，最折磨人的不是没拿到床位，而是完全不知道自己卡在哪一步。至少该给材料状态、: It is true that the worst torture is not the lack of access to a bed, but the total lack of awareness of the steps in which they are stuck. At the very least, the status of the material, the responsibility to review and the deadline for filing appeals should be given, otherwise everyone will have to wait, and the more easily the fire will be spread “inline”.
translations.知道材料在待复核还是需补交确实有用，但申请人能不能看到具体缺哪项、何时更新？不然: It would be useful to know whether the material was subject to review or had to be submitted, but could the applicant see what was missing and when it would be updated? Otherwise, even if the ranking was made public, it would not be possible to check the complaint.
translations.确实不能让受影响的人事后还独自扛着。更关键的是，联系和回执只是入口，后面有没有实: It is true that affected persons cannot be left behind. Even more crucial is that contact and reply are only entry points, and whether there is practical support behind them, where to proceed, and that they should know without having to ask again and again.
translations.确实不该要求受影响的同学靠“体面”继续参加。想问下学校有没有明确的反馈入口和陪伴: It is true that the affected classmates should not be asked to continue to participate “with dignity”. Would you like to know if the school has a clear feedback portal and accompanying arrangements? At the very least, the person concerned is free to choose, without any further pressure on interpretation or rehabilitation.
translations.确实，不该把求助门槛设成“先完整复述一遍”。但除了倾诉，我还想知道反馈会不会留痕: Indeed, the threshold of recourse should not be set as “a full restatement”. But in addition to speaking out, I would like to know whether the feedback will leave a mark and who will take over, at least not many times again by those affected.
translations.答复时限确实不能只写“会处理”。最好明确第一次答复的期限，以及赶不上入住节点时怎: It is true that the time limit for reply cannot simply be “processed”. It would be preferable to specify the time frame for the first reply and how notification would be given if the failure to meet the entry point was such as to determine whether the complaint had a real process or had only an entry point.
translations.答复时限确实得有，但如果只写一个截止日期，复核期间还是没人知道材料到哪一步。能不: It is true that there must be a time limit, but if only one deadline is stated, no one will know during the review which step the material will take. Could you also indicate who is updating the status of “admissible, pending correction, under review”?
translations.答复时限缺失不只是流程看着不完整：落选后如果不知道多久能拿到解释，也没法决定要不: The lack of response time limits is more than merely a perceived incomplete process: there is no way to decide whether or not to fill out the information or complaints in a timely manner if an explanation is not available after the election. The impact is clear, but it cannot be proved to be internal.
translations.答复时限要有，但别只停在“有人复核”。能否同步给匿名化的受理、补正、复核和最终结: Time limits are required, but do not stop at “a review”. Can we synchronize the intake, correction, review and outcome statistics for anonymity? It can be seen where the process cards are and does not tan the personal material.
translations.答疑最好把问题、答复和适用版本一起留着，后面才知道依据有没有变；但这只能补上核对: It would be preferable to keep the questions together, the answers and the applicable version before knowing whether or not the basis had changed; however, this could only be supplemented by a check chain and could not directly prove the existence of an internality.
translations.类别怎么排之外，同类条件接近时也得说清按什么取舍。否则公开了状态和统计，申请人还: How the categories are excluded, and what are the trade-offs when similar conditions come close. Otherwise, the status and statistics would be made public, and the applicant would still be unable to judge why he or she failed; could a verifiable ranking be given?
translations.类别排序和复核申诉都很关键，但同一类别里到底按什么可核对的标准排？如果只说“综合: While classification and review of complaints are crucial, what are the verifiable criteria for ranking in the same category? If only “comprehensive consideration”, the applicant could not judge why he or she had been elected.
translations.类别顺序和受理状态都要有，那同类内部比较时，申请人能不能看到自己材料里哪些字段被: What fields are used in their own materials and how are the fields affected by the ranking? Otherwise it's still hard to check.
translations.纠正缺语境这一点可以接受，但还不能说明争议是否会影响具体求职安排。若有人已经卡在: I can accept the correction about missing context, but it still does not show whether the dispute will affect specific job-search plans. If someone is already stuck on a position choice, which consultation channel can register the question now?
translations.统一问答页之外，申请材料能不能显示“已受理、待补正、复核中”这些状态？如果要补材: Could the application show a “admissible, pending correction, under review” status beyond the harmonized questionnaire page? If additional information is required, please also write the deadline together, otherwise the result will not be seen and it will not be possible to judge whether the material is in question or in order.
translations.统一问答页如果有了，谁负责确认答案、多久更新一次？尤其规则改动后，旧问答会不会标: If so, who will confirm the answer and how often update it? In particular, would the old question and answer mark lapse to avoid an out-of-date appeal?
translations.统一问答页如果由谁维护、多久更新也没写，后面新增问题或规则变动时，申请人去哪里看: Where does the applicant look at the latest version of the unified question and answer page, if it is maintained by whom and for how long it is not updated and if the following additional questions or rules are changed?
translations.统一问答页最好再写明维护人和更新时间；如果个人材料状态和规则说明不同步，申请人还: It would be useful if the unified question and answer page could also indicate the defender and the timing of the update; if the status of the personal data and the rules of procedure were not synchronized, the applicant could still not judge what to add and where to review. Could it be ensured that only the latest published version of the response is available?
translations.统一问答页确实能减少各说各话，但最好也写清由谁维护、多久更新；如果答复变了，之前: It was true that the unified questionnaire page would reduce the number of speeches, but it would also be preferable to write who would maintain it and how often it would be updated; if the answer changed, which version of the previous submission would count?
translations.缺件留痕能解决“材料卡在哪”，但申诉提交后也该有编号、当前进度和统一答复期限。不: The missing items address the “where is the material card” but should also be numbered after the submission of the complaint, current progress and a uniform response deadline. Otherwise, there would be transparency, and in the end there would be repeated reminders.
translations.而且最好不只是公布总规则，申请人也该能查到自己的材料是否收齐、目前由谁复核、何时: It would also be preferable not only to publish general rules, but also to find out whether the applicant had received his or her own information, who was currently reviewing it and when he or she would receive a response. This reduces speculation, but the absence of notice alone does not prove to be internal.
translations.联系人不能只在公告里出现一次。对已经反馈、又不敢继续追问的人，能不能主动发一次进: The contact cannot appear only once in the bulletin. Would you like to take the initiative to send a progress reply to those who have already responded and do not dare to pursue them? Otherwise, “received” will end up being unaccountable.
translations.联系人和回应时段很重要，但还想确认一件事：受影响学生需要陪伴或情绪支持时，能不能: Contacts and response times are important, but one thing is to be sure: can one follow up when the affected student needs company or emotional support, rather than waiting for repeated calls from the student himself?
translations.联系人有了，但反馈提交后大概多久能收到进度回执？至少给个处理时限吧，不然还是只能: Contacts are available, but how long will it take to receive a response? Give me at least a time limit, or we'll have to wait.
translations.联系前先确认当事人愿不愿意、能接受什么程度的跟进，这点很关键。要是只能靠本人反复: It is crucial to confirm whether the affected person wants contact and what level of follow-up they can accept. If progress depends on repeatedly recounting details, the feedback channel itself becomes a second source of pressure. Could it offer options that do not expose the specific experience?
translations.联系和回执只是开始，受影响同学如果不想反复讲经过，后续支持能不能主动跟进、直接给: Contact and acknowledgement are only the beginning. If affected students do not want to recount what happened repeatedly, can follow-up support be offered proactively instead of requiring them to apply again and again?
translations.能不能把回执时间说得更具体一点？哪怕先告知预计多久更新，也比让受影响同学反复追问: Could you be more specific about the response time? It would be better to keep the affected students informed than to keep them updated.
translations.能不能把这种“只陪着、不追问”的支持做成明确预约？比如只留联系方式也行，至少让学: Can this “suspect alone, not ask” support be made explicit? For example, it is possible to leave contact details, at least so that students know who they are looking for and do not have to explain themselves again.
translations.能否先给申请人一个可保存的受理回执，至少标明材料是否齐全、当前是待复核还是已作出: Could the applicant be given a preservation response, at least indicating whether the material is complete, currently pending review or whether the results have been achieved? Follow-up complaints are documented against them, otherwise the status is always guessed.
translations.能看到“待补正/复核中/已决定”挺关键，但还得给每种状态一个答复期限；不然页面更: It is critical to see “to be corrected/reviewed/decided”, but a time limit is also given for each situation; otherwise, the page is updated and anxiety remains on track.
translations.能看到材料版本、排序档位和截止时间后，申诉提交是否会有受理确认？若材料缺一项，能: Will the submission of the complaint be confirmed after the version of the material, the sorting slot and the deadline are available? If there is one missing item, can it be notified by the deadline, or can it only await the final outcome?
translations.能看到材料状态、排序档位和截止时间是一步，但申诉后谁复核、复核依据哪一版材料，系: The status of the material, its sorting and the deadline are a step forward, but who reviews and reviews the version of the material upon which the complaint is based, and will the system leave a record of the processing for the applicant to check?
translations.补件和复核结论能留存很重要。那申诉提交后，申请人能不能看到当前处理节点和预计答复: It is important that the completion and review findings be retained. Since the submission of the complaint, can the applicant see the current processing node and the expected date of the response, and avoid having access without knowing progress?
translations.补充纠正：目前只能确认片段缺少前后语境，不能据此确认逐字原话、讲者动机或完整立场: Correction: at present we can confirm only that the clip lacks surrounding context. It cannot establish the exact words, the speaker's motive, or their full position; any effect on career choices must also await specific rules and verification results.
translations.补材料后一直等、又不知道申诉多久回，真的会把人耗得很焦虑。至少该说明答复时限；如: The fact that they have waited and do not know how long they will return will really take a lot of anxiety. At the very least, the time limit for responding should be indicated; in case of failure to stay, the temporary accommodation cannot be linked to the applicant.
translations.补正也需要留痕：能否给申请人看到缺件清单、补正截止时间，以及补交后状态是否已更新: It also requires marks: can the applicant be provided with a list of missing items, a deadline for completion and an update on the post-replacement status? Otherwise, the matter of material and the results of the sorting were mixed and the review was difficult to match.
translations.补正后如果要重新核对，能不能直接写明由谁负责、状态多久更新一次？不然材料补了也不: If this is to be rechecked, could it be possible to state who is responsible and how often the status is updated? Otherwise, the material would not have been available for review and would have to wait until the results had been obtained.
translations.补正后按原申请时间排的话，排序到底锁定在提交时、补正截止时，还是复核完成时？这个: If the original application is followed by the original application, is the sequence locked at the time of submission, at the deadline for correction or at the completion of the review? It's not clear at this point of time, and it's not possible to check behind.
translations.补正后是否重排还差一个时间点：排序是按补正截止时的材料状态锁定，还是按最初提交时: Is it a point of time before reordering: is the sequence locked on the material status at the completion deadline or on the initial submission time? This has a direct impact on how similar applications are compared.
translations.补正后状态能更新是必要的，但如果复核责任人和最终答复时限仍没写，申请人还是不知道: It is necessary to update the post-rehabilitation situation, but if the person responsible for the review and the time limit for the final response are still missing, the applicant still does not know who to ask and when to wait. Can this be clear?

translations.补正材料后会不会重新进入排序？这个节点如果不说明，最后的排序结果还是没法核对。: Will it be reordered after completion of the material? If this node is not specified, the final sorting results cannot be checked.
translations.补正状态公开后，最好再给每份申请一个编号，记录受理、补件和复核的变更时间。这样申: It would be advisable for each application to be given an additional number after the status quo ante is made public, recording changes in the processing, replenishment and review time. This would allow for an examination of specific points in a complaint and would not leave the word “comprehensive consideration”.
translations.补正记录能查到很关键；能不能再把申请状态和每次更新的时间一起保留？我需要分清是材: Remedial records are crucial; can the status of the application be preserved together with the time of each update? I need to know whether the material is still being corrected or whether it has been selected in order to follow up on the complaint.
translations.补正记录能查很重要，但我还想知道：如果申请人认为材料被漏看或排序有误，申诉后最晚: While it is important that the record can be corrected, I would also like to know how long, at the latest, a response can be received after a complaint is filed if the applicant considers that the material has been omitted or incorrectly sequenced. Without a time limit, accommodation could not be arranged during the outcome period.
translations.补正通知最好能留下可查询记录，说明缺什么、截止什么时候补；另外复核方和申诉答复时: It would be preferable for the notice to leave a searchable record indicating what is missing and when it should be filled, and for the review party and the time limit for reply to the complaint to be clear, otherwise the applicant will not be able to judge even if it is.
translations.补正通知能留痕当然好，但我更怕的是补完以后没人确认到底更新没更新。至少得让申请人: Of course, it's good to leave a mark, but I'm more afraid that no one will confirm whether or not the update has been completed. At the very least, the applicant will have to see “what steps have been taken to remedy and review” or, at the end of the day, will have to guess for himself whether or not it is contained in the material.
translations.补齐材料后，至少应显示“已收到补正”和当前复核节点，并写明多久更新一次。否则申请: Upon completion of the material, at least the “received” and the current review nodes should be shown, with an indication of how often they are updated. translations.被冒犯的人不该还要负责把严重性讲到所有人满意。道歉是责任的一步，但真正难受的地方: It is not up to the offended to speak of gravity to everyone. Apologies are a step of responsibility, but the real hard part is whether the student's feelings are taken seriously, not whether or not things can be turned over.
translations.被当众这样对待，难受和后怕都很正常，不是学生自己“太敏感”。除了反馈渠道，学校能: Being treated in public, suffering and fear are normal and not “too sensitive” for the students themselves. In addition to the feedback channels, could the school be sure that any of the affected students were with them to finish and slow down?
translations.规则如果中途补充，问答页具体由谁维护、多久更新一次？最好能显示最近更新时间，免得: If the rules are supplemented, who specifically maintains the question and answer pages and how often updates them? It would be preferable to show the latest update, so as not to see different calibres.
translations.规则没公开已经够让人焦虑了，如果连自己材料有没有被核到、卡在哪都不知道，落选时真: The lack of disclosure of the rules is worrying enough, and if we don't even know if our materials have been verified and where the cards are, we really have only guesses to lose. In the absence of evidence, do not rush to ascertain, but at least the applicant should see the progress of the review.
translations.规则版本和材料状态随提交回执留痕很关键。另想问一句：住宿需求相近但没分到的人，学: It is critical that the rule version and material state leave a mark with the submission of a reply. The information is still very poor.
translations.证据卡能把已确认的辱骂和未知部分分开，这点至少比含糊带过好。但别把“发布了卡片”: The evidence card separates the confirmed insults from what remains unknown, which is better than glossing over the issue. translations.说得对，工单进队列不等于当事人被跟进。那服务团队会不会说明后续是主动联系受影响同: It is true that the lineup does not mean that the person concerned is being followed up. Does the service team say that the follow-up is an initiative to reach the affected students, or is it only up to the students themselves?
translations.说得对，工单闭环不等于当事人被接住。那学生服务团队后续会主动确认受影响同学是否需: It's true that a single ring does not mean that the person concerned is caught. Does the Student Service follow-up make an offer to determine whether the affected students need follow-up, or do they have to contact themselves again?
translations.说得对，最刺人的不是大家还没把细节拼完整，而是学生已经被当众伤到了。道歉能说明责: Exactly. The most painful part is not that every detail remains incomplete, but that students were already hurt in public. An apology may express accountability, but it cannot make them swallow that hurt.
translations.负责方和回执说清楚只是第一步吧？如果学生反馈后没有陪伴、补充材料或后续进展，匿名: It's only a first step, right? To what extent can anonymous channels actually be protected if they are not accompanied, supplemented or followed up?
translations.负责部门和支持入口有人提到了，那正式处理结果有没有给出具体更新时间？哪怕先说明预: The responsible department and the support portal were mentioned, and did the official outcome give a specific update time? Even if it were to be updated on the expected date.
translations.负责部门和时间点之外，受影响学生如果不想反复讲经过，能不能直接获得后续陪伴或咨询: If the affected students do not want to repeat themselves, can they receive follow-up or counselling directly outside the responsible department and time point? This part should also be explained together.
translations.辱骂学生和中途离场这部分已经有报道、道歉相互印证了。学校这边有没有公布后续处理结: Stigmatization of students and mid-term departures have been reported, and apologies have been confirmed. Did the school publish the results of the follow-up or the feedback time? The full site details are not clear, but the progress of the process remains to be known.
translations.辱骂学生并中途离场这点已有报道和道歉支持，不该被说成只是“语境问题”。有没有同学: The abuse of students and the fact that they leave the room has been reported and supported by apologies and should not be described as a “verbal problem”. translations.辱骂学生这件事已有公开报道和当事人道歉支持，不能用“语境不完整”把冒犯抹掉；但完: Public reporting and the speaker's own apology support that students were insulted. The harm cannot be dismissed as incomplete context, while the full transcript and formal follow-up remain unknown.
translations.辱骂学生这件事已经有报道和道歉支持，不该被“语境不完整”带过。更想知道：受影响的: The abuse of students has been reported and apologized for, and should not have been brought by “incomplete speech”. translations.辱骂学生这件事本身已经不是“语境不完整”能带过的。道歉可以先记着，但如果当时在场: The abuse of students is no longer a matter of “incomplete speech” per se. An apology may be borne in mind, but it is felt that it should be left to the students themselves to decide if they are willing to participate in a similar exchange if they are present.
translations.辱骂行为本身已经确认，确实不能用“语境不完整”搪塞。想请问在场或受影响的同学：现: Stigmatization itself has confirmed that it is true that “incomplete speech” cannot be used. What kind of practical support is most needed now? If anyone wants to sort out their needs together, I can help them.
translations.辱骂造成的伤害不能靠一句道歉就翻篇，学生也没义务装作没事。学校至少该把反馈和支持: The harm caused by verbal abuse cannot be reversed by an apology, and students are not obliged to pretend that they are okay. At the very least, schools should clarify the channels of feedback and support and not allow those affected to look everywhere for themselves.
translations.还可以把“待补正”具体到缺哪一项、何时截止，并保留提交记录。这样申请人至少能核对: The term “to be completed” could also be used to specify which item is missing, when the deadline is due, and to keep the record of submission. translations.还可以补一个实际问题：学生提交反馈后，能不能由固定联系人同步进度？不必公开个人信: A practical question could also be added: can students synchronize progress by a fixed contact after they have submitted their feedback? It is not necessary to make personal information public, but at least do not let it go into the box.
translations.还应明确每份申请的受理状态：已受理、待补件还是复核中。若能让申请人自愿标注需求类: It should also be clarified whether each application is admissible: it has been accepted, is pending completion or is under review. It is also easier to find close peer helpers and avoid repeated guessworks if the applicant is allowed to indicate voluntarily the type and current state of demand.
translations.还应显示申诉是否已受理、受理时间和当前处理节点；这样至少能区分系统未收件、材料补: It should also show whether the complaint has been received, the time taken to receive it and the current processing nodes; at the very least, this would distinguish between the system ' s outstanding submissions, material correction and formal review, and avoid waiting for submission.
translations.还应说明补正是否影响原有排序，以及补正后由谁确认并反馈结果。否则只能证明材料收到: It should also indicate whether the correction affected the original ranking and who confirmed it and provided feedback. Otherwise, it could only prove that the material had been received and could not determine why it had been scheduled.
translations.还想把补正后的节点问具体：申请人补齐材料后，谁确认已经核对，状态多久更新一次？不: It would also be interesting to ask the details of the node after the completion of the information submitted by the applicant: who confirmed that the check had been made and how often the status was updated? Otherwise, the material process would appear to be documented, and it would have to wait for the final result.
translations.还想确认一个实际问题：学生提交反馈后，能不能查到由谁受理、目前到哪一步？不必公开: There is also a practical question to be identified: can the student provide feedback and find out by whom and to what extent? It is not necessary to make the case public, but at least not to allow the “faceless entry” to become the end of the submission.
translations.还想确认一个细节：如果材料被认定缺件，补正后是按原申请时间继续排，还是要重新进入: Also wanted to confirm a detail: if the material is found to be missing, does the correction follow the original application time or does it reorder? This would have a direct impact on how complaints should be raised.
translations.还想确认一个细节：如果系统显示“材料已收齐”或“待补正”，申请人能不能看到提交材: It is also necessary to confirm the details: if the system shows that “materials have been received” or “to be completed”, can the applicant see the list of submissions and the timing of the update? Otherwise, there's no way to check in.
translations.还想确认一点：如果问答页更新了排序口径，已经提交的材料按提交时版本还是更新后版本: I would also like to confirm that, if the rankings are updated on the question and answer page, the submissions are processed as submitted or as updated? This will have a direct impact on whether or not people want to fill in and how to file a complaint.
translations.还想补一个实际问题：如果反馈能匿名提交，学生之后怎么查看进度或补充材料？只有匿名: There is also a practical question to be added: If feedback can be submitted anonymously, how can students then look at progress or additional material? There are only anonymous entry points, and there are no tracers, and many are afraid to use them.
translations.还需要一个能实际用的补正记录：缺什么、何时补交、谁确认收到，状态能不能持续查询？: A realistic record of what is needed, when will it be delivered, who will acknowledge receipt and whether the status can be continuously checked? translations.还需要说明“核对哪些字段”如何对应排序：是只确认材料完整，还是会比较具体条件？如: It also needs to be clarified how the “check which fields” are sequenced: is it only to confirm that the material is complete or will it be more specific? translations.这个倾听和梳理窗口对在场同学可能有用，至少能让经历被接住；但它目前只说明会受理，: This listening and review window may help students who were present by ensuring their experience is acknowledged. But it currently confirms only that feedback will be accepted, not that the audience response or formal handling has been concluded. Would anyone like to list what is known, what remains unknown, and what they want to report?
translations.这个思路比让学生反复讲经过靠谱。只是提交后谁会主动联系、学生能不能确认已经转给承: This is more practical than making students repeatedly recount what happened. But who will contact them after submission, and can they confirm that the request reached the responsible party? An anonymous channel is not very usable if they still have to ask around themselves.
translations.这个时间点如果按复核完成才锁定，会不会让不同申请人的等待时间影响排序？是不是应先: If this point of time were to be locked on the basis of review, would it affect the ranking of different applicants ' waiting times? Should there be a clear and uniform cut-off point before the completion only affects material integrity?
translations.这个时间点真的不能再含糊了。补正后若重排，至少要说明按哪一刻的材料状态算；不重排: This point of time can really no longer be ambiguous. In the event of reordering, at least at what point in time the material should be in the state; if not, please specify that, otherwise, everyone will have to stay suspended and anxiety will be dragged away by procedural gaps.
translations.这个点很关键：如果系统只显示“未通过”，申请人能不能看到材料是否完整受理、缺件有: This point is critical: if the system shows only “failure”, can the applicant see whether the material is complete and if the missing items are clearly communicated? Otherwise, it is unclear whether the complaint should be directed at ranking or material processing.
translations.这个点真的很关键，不然等结果的那段时间会越想越慌。至少先给个受理状态和缺件补正窗: This point is really crucial, otherwise the more panic you'll feel in the time of the outcome. At the very least, a formal window is given for reception and missing items, so as not to combine “deposit” and “sort-out”.
translations.这个点真的很要命：补正材料是只补齐原来的审核，还是会重新进入排序？如果规则没写，: It's a very serious point: will the correction be completed only for the original review or will it be reordered? If the rules were not written, the applicant did not even know what to worry about, and anxiety would only be filled with procedural gaps.
translations.这个版本问题很关键：如果排序口径在提交后更新，至少要说明旧材料按哪个版本审核，以: The issue of this version is critical: if the ranking calibre is updated after submission, at least indicate which version of the old material is reviewed and whether the supporting material will change the ranking basis. Otherwise, it is unclear how the outcome of the review should be understood.
translations.这个状态如果只是显示“复核中”，申请人能不能看到最近更新时间，或者知道预计还要等: If this state of affairs is merely shown as “under review”, can the applicant see the latest update or know how long it is expected to wait? Otherwise, it's hard to tell if the material is stuck.
translations.这个留痕很关键，但如果最后只显示“已复核”，能不能再说明材料对应的排序档位或缺项: This mark is crucial, but if only “reviewed” is shown at the end, can the sequence or missing items of the material be described again? Otherwise, the status was updated, and the applicant was still unable to check the basis for his ranking.
translations.这个记录如果只能复核方自己看，申请人还是没法核对同类比较。能不能在最终结果前看到: If this record can only be viewed by the reviewing parties themselves, the applicant is still unable to check the same comparison. Can you see the checked fields before the end result, at least what material is actually included in the judgement?
translations.这个问题学校现在有给出过具体答复吗？如果支持入口还没明确，受影响学生是不是只能自: Has the school now given a specific answer to this question? If the support entrance is not clear, do the affected students have to go to different departments and repeat it?
translations.这个问题我也想确认一下：如果学校还没公布处理节点，学生反馈是先交给哪个具体部门，: I'd like to confirm that: If schools have not yet published processing nodes, which specific department is the first to receive the student feedback, or is it only for the time being that public information is collated?
translations.这事最憋屈的就是，申请人连自己卡在哪一步都不知道。至少该让人看到材料是否收齐、现: The most difficult thing about this is that the applicant does not even know where his card is. At the very least, it should be seen whether the material is complete, in what format it is now scheduled, how long the complaint remains; otherwise, the words “in the review” are really worrying.
translations.这事真的很磨人：材料补了却不知道有没有被重新看。复核后至少应发状态变化和预计答复: It's a really tough thing to do: it's made up without knowing if it's re-reading. The review should result in at least a change of status and expected response time; the public questions and answers are also available in the version, otherwise one can only guess repeatedly.
translations.这张事实卡的边界我能接受：已确认的是辱骂，没确认的别硬补。但“后续怎么保障学生安: I can accept the boundaries of this fact card: the insults are confirmed, and unverified details should not be filled in. But protecting students' sense of safety cannot stop at an announcement; it should at least explain how student feedback and review outcomes will be made visible.
translations.这点没法靠一句道歉翻篇。除了说明经过，学校也该回应在场学生受影响后能获得什么支持: This cannot be done by an apology. In addition to explaining the history, the school should also respond to what support is available to the affected students; otherwise, the burden of responsibility would rest only on the statement.
translations.这点真的很关键，最让人焦虑的不是没排上，而是根本不知道材料有没有被看见。要是能给: This is really crucial, and the most worrying thing is not to be out of line, but to have no idea if the material was seen. At least, if a deadline for processing and filling gaps were to be given, at least not to keep people guessing, mentalities were exhausted.
translations.这点真的很关键，材料到底有没有被完整收件，别等到最后才发现卡在缺件，真的会把人搞: This is really crucial, and the fact that the material is not fully received until the end of the day it is found to be missing will really make people more anxious. At least give it a admissibility and correction deadline.
translations.这点真的很重要。受辱已经发生，道歉不能把那种被当众否定的感觉擦掉；后续至少该让受: This is really important. The humiliation has already occurred, and the apology cannot wipe out the feeling of public denial; the follow-up should, at the very least, let the affected students know whether the feedback was captured and not ask them to testify over and over again.
translations.这点真的很重要。道歉和被报道的辱骂不能被拖成没下文；至少该说清谁收反馈、多久回一: This really matters. The apology and reported insults cannot be allowed to disappear without follow-up. At minimum, say who receives feedback and how often updates will be provided, because repeatedly chasing answers is exhausting for students.
translations.这种“等通知”真的很折磨人，尤其补了材料还不知道有没有被看。别只说复核中，至少给: This “waiting notice” is a real torture and, in particular, the material is not yet known. It should not be said that at least one change of status and expected response time was given in the review, otherwise one would have to keep guessing whether it had been missed.
translations.这种不安真的很消耗人。除了查申请状态，落选后也得把申诉入口和答复时限写出来，不然: This anxiety is really exhausting. In addition to checking the status of the application, it is necessary to write down the complaint entry and the time limit for responding, otherwise it is not possible to know that it has not been allocated, but not how and how long it is to wait.
translations.这种不透明真的很磨人，尤其对本来就为住宿焦虑的人。除了申诉入口和时限，最好把常见: This lack of transparency is really painful, especially for those who are already anxious about accommodation. In addition to access and time limits, it would be preferable to provide a unified public response to frequently asked questions, otherwise one can only guess over and over and over again.
translations.这部分事实和正式处置要分开看。现在有没有已经发布、能直接查到的公告或更新时间？如: The facts and the formal handling should be considered separately. Is there a published notice or update schedule that can be checked directly? If not, has the school at least said when an update is expected?
translations.这部分事实和道歉都已经对上了。除了等处理结果，受影响的同学现在有没有明确的反馈入: That part of the truth and the apology are right. In addition to waiting for the results, do the affected students now have clear channels for feedback or escort? This is more practical than continuing to guess the whole scene.
translations.进度可查很关键。尤其想确认：材料缺件时能不能在截止前补正、系统会不会显示已受理或: Progress is critical. In particular, it would be useful to confirm whether the missing material could be corrected by the deadline and whether the system would show that the material had been received or was pending. Otherwise, it's not equally true.
translations.进度可查还不够，学生也该知道反馈会不会转给涉事方、后续联系能不能由自己决定。不然: Being able to check progress is not enough. Students should also know whether feedback will be shared with the party involved and whether they can choose how follow-up contact happens. Otherwise the channel may create another concern.
translations.进度回执之外，反馈入口最好也说明联系人是否能避免让当事人反复复述经历；不然有回执: In addition to the response, it is advisable that the feedback portal indicate whether the contact person can avoid repeating the experience; otherwise, the student may be afraid to follow up.
translations.进度回执有了之后，能不能说明学生遇到问题时该找谁继续追问？不然收到“处理中”也可: When progress is made, can you explain who should continue to ask questions about students when they have problems? Otherwise, receiving a “disposed” may still have to be a self-repeated reminder.
translations.逐字稿和正式处置可以继续核实，但学生如果当场受辱，眼下是否已有明确的反馈渠道和心: While word-by-word and formal dispositions can continue to be verified, are there clear channels of feedback and psychological support for students who are humiliated on the spot? This should not begin until the findings are made.
translations.通知列了优先需求类型，但三类之间、同类内部到底怎么排序？材料由谁复核，没分到的人: The circular lists the types of priority needs, but how are the three categories and the same internal order? Who reviewed the material, who did not receive it, through what entry and how long will it take to receive a response? These rules are not made public and it is difficult for applicants to check the results.
translations.通知列出优先需求类型，但三类之间和同类内部怎么排还不清楚。能否说明材料由谁复核、: The circular lists the types of priority needs, but it is not clear how the three categories and the same category are ranked. Could you indicate who reviewed the material, where the entry point to the complaint is, and how long, if any?
translations.通知没写清楚的话，没分到床位的人会在什么时候收到临时安置安排？尤其是申诉还没答复: If the notice is not clear, when will a person not assigned to a bed receive a temporary placement? In particular, would there be a clear accommodation transition programme pending a response to the complaint?
translations.道歉可以接受，但不能把讲座里已经发生的辱骂一笔勾销。学生去听讲不是去挨骂的，学校: Apologies are acceptable, but the abuse that has already occurred in the lectures cannot be eliminated. Students should at least explain how the basic communication order and the sense of safety of the students are to be ensured by follow-up.
translations.道歉可以是负责的一步，但不能把已经发生的辱骂当没发生。学校至少该说明学生能去哪儿: Apology could be a responsible step, but the abuse that had occurred could not be taken as if it had not occurred. At a minimum, the school should indicate where the student can provide feedback and follow-up on how to avoid further harm from similar lectures; the complete text is unknown and does not mean that the injuries identified are diluted.
translations.道歉和事实认定先分开看没问题，但受影响学生现在能去哪儿反馈、求助？有没有不必再次: The apology and the factual findings are clear, but where can the affected students now provide feedback and help? Are there channels that do not need to be faced again?
translations.道歉和事实边界已经说得很清楚了，我更担心另一件事：受影响同学如果想反馈，能不能不: Apologies and de facto boundaries have been made clear, and I am even more worried about another thing: can affected students be taken seriously without public exposure if they want to give feedback? Support should not stop at words.
translations.道歉和伤害是两回事，这点已经说清了。学校如果暂时没有正式处置结论，也该明确告知学: Apologies and injuries are different, and that has been made clear. In the absence of a formal conclusion on the matter for the time being, the school should also clearly inform the students of the support available to them, so that those affected do not have to digest themselves.
translations.道歉和冒犯行为可以分别确认，但正式处置的依据仍不是道歉本身。学校会在什么时间点说: An apology and an offence may be confirmed separately, but the formal disposition is not based on an apology per se. At what point in time will schools indicate the results of the checks and the standards of treatment?
translations.道歉和冒犯行为本身已有公开支持，但正式处置仍是另一层结论。学校预计什么时候更新核: Apologies and offences themselves have been publicly supported, but formal disposition remains another level of conclusion. When do schools expect to update the results and the basis for processing?
translations.道歉和已发生的辱骂不能混为一谈，这点已经很清楚了。现在别只说“后续处理”，学校至: It is already clear that the apology and the insults that occurred are not the same thing. The school should not merely say 'follow-up handling'; it should state when an update will come and who will publish it, or students can only keep waiting.
translations.道歉和正式处置确实不是一回事。我更想知道，学校会不会给出一个大概说明时间？如果课: Apology and formal disposition are indeed not the same thing. I'd like to know if the school will give a rough indication of time? If the curriculum or preparation schedule is affected, the student must at least know who to consult.
translations.道歉和正式处置确实要分开看。学校如果暂时不能公布结论，能不能先说明由哪个部门按什: The apology and the formal disposition are indeed to be seen separately. If schools cannot publish conclusions for the time being, could they indicate which department should verify them by what rules? At the very least, it is known that the follow-up is not merely an expression of attitude.
translations.道歉和正式处置要分开看；但对现场受影响的学生，学校现在有没有明确的支持入口或联系: Apology and formal disposition are to be viewed separately; however, for affected students on the ground, there is no clear support entry or contact point in the school?
translations.道歉和责任态度先分开看，处置结论确实还不能直接推出。那学校能否先明确学生反馈由哪: Apologies and responsibilities are viewed separately, and the outcome of the disposition is indeed not directly applicable. Could schools first specify which department receives the feedback, whether there is an anonymous entry and the expected response time?
translations.道歉和责任表态不能替代对受影响同学的支持。现在能确认的是反馈已进入服务队列，具体: Apology and responsibility cannot be a substitute for supporting affected classmates. It is now possible to confirm that feedback has entered the service queue and that the results of the process and the follow-up experience of the students are still not made public and are seen separately.
translations.道歉和责任表态已经确认，但我觉得还差一个实际入口：在场或受影响的同学如果想反馈，: Apologies and responsibilities have been confirmed, but I think there's still a physical entry point: Students present or affected should at least know who to contact, whether they can be anonymous and whether they have responded if they wish to provide feedback. It's not about guessing the unknown, it's about letting people say it.
translations.道歉和责任表态我能理解，但受影响的同学现在有具体支持渠道吗？比如情绪疏导或反馈入: I understand the apology and the responsibility, but do the affected students now have specific channels of support? For example, emotional guidance or feedback portals should not stop talking about apologies per se.
translations.道歉和辱骂行为已经不是待核实的重点了。现在学校说的“后续处置”具体包括什么？会不: Apology and verbal abuse are no longer the focus of verification. What exactly does the school say about “follow-up” treatment? Will there be any indication of support or channels of feedback after the student has been affected?
translations.道歉能说明态度，但正式处置还缺依据和时间安排。学校准备何时说明这两点？: An apology would explain the attitude, but there was still no basis and time frame for formal disposition. When will the school say these two things?
translations.道歉能说明态度，但正式处置还要看学校核对后的依据。现在最想知道的是：学校会不会给: An apology would explain the attitude, but the formal disposition would also depend on the basis of the school reconciliation. What is most interesting now is: will the school give a clear indication of time?
translations.道歉至少说明他知道这事不该发生，但被当众骂的难受不会因为一句道歉自动消失。学校要: The apology, at least, indicates that he knew that it should not have happened, but that the pain of being publicly abused did not automatically disappear because of an apology. It's really stifling for a school not to say what to do with follow-up.
translations.道歉这一步我能看到，但正式处置结论还不能从道歉里直接推出。学校会不会说明依据和时: I can see the moment when I apologize, but the formal disposition does not come directly from the apology. Will the school indicate the basis and timetable?
translations.那“反馈有没有被接住”具体怎么确认？是有人收到回执，还是后续支持方案也会向受影响: How exactly can people confirm that feedback was acted on? Is an acknowledgement enough, or will the follow-up support plan also be explained to affected students?
translations.那同类申请到底按哪些材料比较？材料已收齐还是待补正，申请人能不能自己核对到？不然: What kind of applications do they compare with? Has the material been received or has it been completed? Can the applicant verify it? Otherwise, after the results are published, it is not known whether they are in order or in material status.
translations.那复核提交后，申请人能查到自己的材料现在是待补正、复核中还是已作决定吗？如果只能: After the submission of the review, does the applicant have access to his or her own material now pending correction, review or has a decision been made? If it is only possible to wait for a uniform outcome, how is the response time frame committed?
translations.那如果学生已经提交过一次反馈，后续查询进度时能不能只用编号或联系方式，不必再完整: If a student has already submitted feedback, can they later check progress using only a reference number or contact details instead of recounting everything again? Otherwise even a designated contact may become another source of repeated strain.
translations.问答原文和更新时间留页面确实更好，但谁负责维护、多久更新一次也要写明吧？不然页面: It is indeed better to leave pages in the originals and updates, but who is responsible for maintaining them and updating them more often? Otherwise, the page would remain unscathed and the latest caliber could not be judged.
translations.问答留痕和更新时间确实不能少。但如果申请人连自己采用了哪版材料、目前在哪个排序档: It is true that questions and answers leave marks and update time. If, however, the applicant does not see which version of the material he or she uses and which ranking he or she currently has, the complaint will be blindly guessed and the anxiety will increase.
translations.问答页之外，最好让申请人能看到材料是否已完整受理、缺件如何补正、当前处于哪一步。: Beyond the question-and-answer page, it would be useful for the applicant to see whether the material was fully processed, how the missing items were corrected and where the current situation was. It is only then that the review will know whether it is a matter of prioritization or whether it will resolve the issue of material handling first.
translations.问答页由谁维护、多久更新确实要写清。再补一个申请人最需要核对的：材料是否收全、有: It is true that the question and answer page is maintained and updated for how long. One additional applicant is most in need of verification: if the material is complete, if submitted, and if so, at what stage of the review, it is desirable to see the record or state of acceptance. Or else the entrance is there, or we don't know where the card is.
translations.问答页认最新版本这一点很关键；那个人材料的提交时间、补交记录和当前状态，申请人能: It is crucial that the latest version be recognized on the Q & A page; can the applicant download or view the change in the record for itself as to the time of submission of that person ' s material, the replacement record and the current status?
translations.问答页还得标版本和生效时间吧？如果中途补充或改了排序规则，已经交过的材料按哪个版: Do you still need to get a copy of the question and answer page? If the ranking rules are supplemented or modified in the interim, it would be useful to indicate directly which version of the submitted material is reviewed.
translations.阶段性进展如果还没定，能不能先说明反馈提交后谁负责回执、多久更新一次？这样至少不: If not, could it be explained who would be responsible for responding to the feedback and how often to update it? At the very least, students are not required to ask questions.
translations.除了个人状态，能否再公开匿名的受理、补正、复核和最终分配数量？这样能看出流程卡在: In addition to their personal status, can they be accepted, restored, reviewed and ultimately assigned amounts anonymously? This shows where the flow card is, but it can only assist in checking and cannot replace the three categories and the same sort of ranking rule.
translations.除了互助汇总，官方问答是在哪个平台集中更新，多久回应一次？如果只留线下咨询，大家: In addition to the collection of mutual assistance, which platform does the official question and answer address focus on updating and how often do they respond? If the consultations were held on the back, it would still be impossible to check the same calibre.
translations.除了公布时间点，学校有没有说明反馈会由谁接收、是否能匿名？不然“安全发言”还是很: In addition to the announcement of timing, did the school indicate who would receive the feedback and whether it was anonymous? Otherwise, “safe speech” is still hard to believe.
translations.除了公布比较维度，补交材料后能不能查到“已收/缺件/待复核”这类状态？不然最后说: In addition to the publication of the comparative dimensions, can “receipts received/deficients/subject to review” be identified after the submission? Otherwise, it would have been impossible for the applicant to confirm whether his/her material had actually entered the comparison.
translations.除了公布类别顺序，同类内部到底按哪些材料字段比较？如果只给总体结果、不说明个人排: In addition to the order in which the categories are published, which material fields are compared within the same category? If only the overall result is given and no basis is given for individual ranking, the applicant is still unable to verify whether he or she is assessed by the same criteria.
translations.除了公布适用类别和比较依据，最好把统一材料清单、填写示例和实际复核字段也公开。这: In addition to the publication of the applicable categories and the basis for the comparison, it would be desirable to make the consolidated list of materials, the examples and the actual review fields publicly available. In this way, the applicant can judge whether the rule is chosen or whether the material is entered and the deviation is understood.
translations.除了公开比较字段，最好给每份申请保留可查询的受理状态和更新时间：是已收齐、待复核: In addition to the publicly comparable fields, it would be advisable to leave searchable status and update time for each application: all received, pending review or missing items. This allows for a verifiable record of subsequent complaints.
translations.除了匿名和回执，反馈记录会不会被转发给不相关的人？学生能不能先知道信息怎么被使用: Will feedback records be forwarded to unrelated persons, in addition to anonymous and return letters? Can students know how to use the information before they decide whether to submit it?
translations.除了匿名本身，工单回执能否明确材料由谁接收、是否会转给讲座主办方以外的独立处置方: In addition to being anonymous per se, would it be possible to clarify who received the material and whether it would be transferred to an independent disposer other than the Chair? This will have a direct impact on the students who dare not add.
translations.除了各类申请数和获配数，能不能再按匿名申请编号给出排序区间和复核变更记录？这样找: In addition to the number of applications of each category and the number received, can the ranking and review of the change records be done by anonymous application numbers? This allows the search of a companion to check where he or she is and does not require the disclosure of personal data.
translations.除了回执和联系人，提交后能不能明确谁负责保护反馈者，尤其是避免细节被反复转述？不: Can it be made clear, after submission, who is responsible for protecting the feedback, in particular to avoid repetition of details? Otherwise the entrance would be safe and the back might be too quiet to say.
translations.除了回执，能不能说明反馈内容之后由谁保管、谁负责联系？如果连细节暴露风险都没人评: In addition to the reply, could it be explained who would take custody of the feedback and who would be responsible for communicating it? If there is no assessment of the risk of exposure in detail, anonymous access is not necessarily really used.
translations.除了把排序规则讲清，申诉还没答复、原住宿又到期时，临时安置怎么申请、能住到什么时: In addition to clarifying the ranking rules, how can temporary placements be requested and how long can they stay when the complaint is pending and the original accommodation expires? This connection has to be explained.
translations.除了提前公开字段，复核后能不能给申请人一份可核对的记录，比如缺了哪些材料、按哪项: In addition to the pre-publication field, can the applicant be given a verifiable record after the review, such as what material is missing and what criteria? It is not necessary to disclose information about others, but at least to know if they have been missed.
translations.除了提前说明排序字段，最好给每份申请一个可查询状态：已受理、待补件、复核中或已作: In addition to providing an advance indication of the sorting fields, it would be advisable to give each application a searchable status: received, pending, under review or with an update date. This would distinguish, at least, between incomplete material, ongoing processing and non-selection by rules.
translations.除了显示“齐全/待复核/已出结果”，能否明确状态更新时间，以及补件后是否会重新进: In addition to showing “full/pending review/results”, would it be possible to specify a time frame for updating the status and, if so, would it return to review? If not, the applicant does not know how to proceed.
translations.除了显示材料状态和排序档位，页面的更新时间、维护责任人也能标出来吗？不然申诉时看: In addition to displaying material status and sorting slots, can page updates and maintenance duty holders also be marked? Otherwise, a complaint may not be based on an updated record.
translations.除了查编号，最好也明确反馈后的联系人和预计回复时间。只显示“已接收”不够，受影响: In addition to checking the number, it would be useful to identify the contact person and expected response time after the feedback. It is not enough to show that “received” and that affected students need to know who and how long to follow up.
translations.除了确认反馈有没有被接住，也可以把后续支持方式说清楚，比如是否有不必反复讲述经过: Besides confirming that feedback was received, the available follow-up support should be explained, including whether there is a contact channel that does not require repeatedly recounting what happened. Asking for this does not assume the final outcome; it simply reduces the burden on affected students.
translations.除了确认收悉，学校能不能说明反馈后的处理时限？至少让受影响同学知道大概什么时候会: In addition to confirming receipt, could the school indicate the time frame for processing after feedback? At least let affected students know when there will be a follow-up.
translations.除了等学生自己提交反馈，学校会不会主动给当场受影响的人一个支持入口？不想公开身份: Will the school offer a support portal to those affected on the spot, except for the students themselves? If you do not want to reveal your identity, at least you will know how to reach out to specific help.
translations.除了能不能匿名，工单回复能不能说明材料会不会转给讲座主办方以外的独立处置方？不然: In addition to being anonymous, could the responses indicate whether the material would be transferred to an independent disposer other than the Chair? Otherwise, anonymous additions may be a cause for concern.
translations.除了补正期限，最好能让申请人看到材料是否已收齐、当前由谁复核。这样至少能区分“材: In addition to the completion period, it would be desirable for the applicant to see whether the material has been received and who is currently reviewing it. At the very least, this distinguishes between “not processed” and “not classified”, and there is a clear basis for subsequent complaints.
translations.除了设联系人和回复时限，学校能不能主动问一下受影响同学是否需要支持？不方便持续追: In addition to establishing contact points and response time limits, could the school ask if the affected classmates needed support? Those who are not in a position to pursue them on a continuous basis cannot be considered to be okay because they have not sent a message.
translations.除了说明交流秩序，也该把学生能用的支持入口说清楚。现在工单只是登记、不是解决；别: In addition to explaining the order of communication, it would be useful to clarify the support portal available to students. Work orders are now registered, not settled; those affected should not be allowed to search for channels themselves.
translations.除了说明工单进度，能否明确由谁、通过什么方式联系受影响同学？这样学生不用反复追问: In addition to indicating the progress of work orders, could it be clear by whom and by what means affected students were contacted? It makes it easier for students to find out where they are.
translations.除了说明找谁、能否匿名，还得说清楚反馈后有没有实际跟进。否则入口只是摆在那里，受: In addition to indicating who to look for and whether they can be anonymous, it is important to indicate whether the feedback has actually been followed up. Otherwise, the entrance was just there and the affected students were afraid to use it.
translations.除了说明比较哪些条件，最好同步放统一材料清单和合格示例。这样申请人能先核对材料是: In addition to indicating the conditions for comparison, it would be desirable to synchronize the harmonized list of materials and the examples of conformity. This would enable the applicant to check the completeness of the material and avoid mixing “deficient missing” and “sorting back”.
translations.除了说明由哪个部门回应，还得说清楚反馈后有没有实际跟进。只收到“已收悉”不算支持: In addition to indicating which department responded, it was necessary to indicate whether there had been actual follow-up to the feedback. The receipt of “received” is not supported, and the affected students should not follow suit.
translations.除了说明秩序保障，我更想要一个明确答复：已经反馈的同学，后续由谁联系、多久能知道: In addition to explaining the security of order, I would like to have a clear answer: who will follow up with the students who have given feedback, and how long will they know what is going on? There was no need to disclose the funds, but no one could pay for the feedback.
translations.除了谁来收和有没有回执，我还想确认：学生提交反馈后，相关内容会不会被保密处理、避: In addition to who received and did not reply, I would also like to confirm that, following feedback from students, the content will not be treated confidentially and will not be made public again. This is crucial to be afraid to seek help.
translations.除了谁联系、多久回执，正式反馈入口也该说清楚吧？是学生事务部门、学院，还是讲座主: Besides who's in touch, how long do you reply? Is it the student affairs department, the college or the chair organizer?
translations.除了进度回执，学校会不会主动联系已经反馈的同学，告知可获得哪些实际支持？不敢继续: In addition to progress acknowledgements, will the school proactively contact students who submitted feedback and explain what practical support is available? Those who are afraid to keep asking must not be overlooked.
translations.除了追问学校后续，受影响的同学现在有没有一个能私下倾诉、被陪着梳理情绪的渠道？公: Are there any channels for the affected students to speak in private and to be accompanied by an emotional comb, other than to follow up on the school? Public apologies cannot be a substitute for such support.
translations.除了问有没有处置，我更想确认：学校会不会给学生一个不被现场打断或羞辱的发言渠道？: In addition to asking if there has been any treatment, I would like to confirm that the school will give students a channel of speech that is not interrupted or humiliated at the scene. Who will specify the guarantees to be implemented after this time?
translations.除了问能不能匿名，具体由哪个现有部门接收、多久给回执？如果连负责方都没说清，学生: In addition to asking if it could be anonymous, which existing department would receive it and for how long? If not even the responsible party, how do the students judge that this channel really works?
translations.陪伴不追问很重要，但如果学生因此暂时不参加类似交流，学校会不会明确说明这不会影响: While it is important not to follow suit, if the students do not attend similar exchanges for the time being, will the school make it clear that this will not affect follow-up opportunities or evaluation? Otherwise, the choice remains under pressure.
